Extras, sirf agar chahein

Aur gehraai mein (3)

  • Case A Trainable Spaced Repetition Model for Language Learning Settles and Meeder, Duolingo, ACL 2016Duolingo kaise tay karta hai ki koi word aapko kab wapas dikhaye, apne learning data se. Is course ki review queue isi idea par chalti hai.
  • Paper Test-Enhanced Learning: Taking Memory Tests Improves Long-Term Retention Roediger and Karpicke, Psychological Science, 2006Yeh course aapse baar-baar sawaal kyun poochta hai: ek hafte baad, dobara padhne se test hona kaafi aage nikalta hai.

Is topic ke shabd (19)

App
Sochiye dukaan ka counter jisme buttons dabane hote hain. App ek program hai jise koi istemal karta hai, jisme buttons hote hain. Model se baat app karta hai. Model ke paas khud koi interface, koi memory nahi hoti, aur use pata nahi ki koi insaan hai.
API
Sochiye ticket counter ki khidki: aap parchi andar dete hain, aur jawaab wapas aata hai. API ek program ka doosre program se internet par kuchh karwane ka tareeka hai. Aap ise dekhte nahi. Jab yeh book kehti hai ki aapka app "API ko call karta hai", matlab aapke app ne model provider ke computers ko ek message bheja aur reply ka intezaar kiya.
JSON
Sochiye ek form jo labels aur values ke roop mein curly brackets ke andar likha ho. JSON structured jaankari ko saade text mein likhne ka tareeka hai jise program padh sake, jaise {"role": "user", "content": "hello"}. Yeh ek data format hai, code ya database nahi. API requests aur responses isi mein likhe jaate hain.
Endpoint
Sochiye dak ghar ka woh khaas counter number jahan ek tarah ka kaam hota hai. Endpoint woh khaas web address hai jis par program apni request bhejta hai. Alag endpoints alag kaam karte hain: ek chat ke liye, ek embeddings ke liye.
Payload
Sochiye lifaafe ke andar ki chitthi: payload chitthi hai, lifaafa nahi. Payload woh hai jo request ya reply ke andar hota hai.
Parameter
Sochiye machine ka dial jo aap start dabane se pehle set karte hain. Parameter ek setting hai jo aap request ke saath dete hain, jaise temperature, maximum length ya kaun sa model. Yahi shabd model ke training se bane arabon andar ke numbers ko bhi kehte hain. Is book mein jab tak alag na likha ho, iska matlab setting hai.
Notebook
Sochiye browser mein kachche kaam ka ek page jahan aap code ki kuchh lines likhkar button dabate hain aur dekhte hain ki kya hota hai. Notebook woh tool hai jo yeh book istemal karti hai taaki aapko kuchh install na karna pade. Usmein aap kuchh bhi karein, kuchh toot nahi sakta.
Runtime
Sochiye udhaar ki rasoi jahan aapka code pakta hai. Runtime woh machine hai jo asal mein aapka code chala rahi hai. Is app mein yeh aapke browser tab ke andar Python hai, isliye reload se nayi shuru hoti hai, aur Restore aapki definitions wapas rakh deta hai. Colab jaisa hosted notebook aapko kuchh ghante ke liye machine udhaar deta hai, phir wapas le leta hai.
Deploy
Sochiye dukaan ka shutter khol dena taaki customers aa sakein. Deploy ka matlab hai badlaav ko aisi jagah rakhna jahan asli users pahunch sakein. Jab tak kuchh deploy nahi hota, woh sirf aapki machine par hota hai.
Rollback
Sochiye naya kharab board lagne ke baad purana board wapas lagana. Rollback bure deploy ke baad pichhla version wapas rakhna hai. Yeh aapka code palat deta hai. Yeh model ka vyavhaar nahi palat sakta, isliye Chapter 18 kehta hai ki kill switch alag cheez hai.
Corpus
Sochiye poori kitaabon ki almari jisse aapka system jawaab de sakta hai. Corpus un sabhi documents ka samooh hai jinse aapka system jawaab de sakta hai: aapka source material ka set. Bahuvachan hai corpora.
Index
Sochiye kitaab ke peechhe ki anukramanika, jisse aap page tezi se dhoondh sakein. Index aapke corpus ki taiyaar ki hui copy hai, aise saji ki usmein search tez ho. Ise banane ko indexing kehte hain. Jab tak index nahi bana, kuchh retrieve nahi ho sakta.
Pipeline
Sochiye assembly line jahan har kaarigar ka kaam agle ko jaata hai. Pipeline steps ka ek kram hai jahan har step ka output agle ka input hai. Ek sire par documents andar jaate hain, doosre sire se jawaab nikalta hai. Chapter 7 aapki pipeline banata hai.
Latency
Sochiye chai ka order dene ke baad intezaar. Latency woh hai jitna user ko intezaar karna padta hai. Ise seconds mein naapa jaata hai, aur yeh ek product decision hai, koi technical baat nahi.
p95
Sochiye chai ke liye 100 log line mein: p95 woh intezaar hai jo 95 logon ko milta hai ya usse behtar. Yeh aapke sabse dheemi paanchve hisse ke users ki baat karta hai, aam user ki nahi. Average in logon ko chhupa deta hai; design p95 par hota hai.
SLA
Sochiye courier ka likha vaada, parcel late hua toh paise wapas. SLA (service-level agreement) supplier ka likha vaada hai uptime ya speed ke baare mein, tootne par nateeje ke saath. Bina nateeje wala vaada marketing ka daava hai, SLA nahi.
Deterministic
Sochiye calculator: ek jaisa hisaab, ek jaisa jawaab, har baar. Deterministic ka matlab hai ek jaisa input, ek jaisa output, har baar. Aam software deterministic hota hai. Language model nahi hota, aur isi se is kshetra ke zyaadatar jhatke aate hain.
Orchestration
Sochiye conductor jo dekhta hai ki band ka har sadasya sahi samay par aaye. Orchestration ka matlab hai kai steps ya kai models ko aise sanyojit karna ki woh sahi kram mein chalein aur ek-doosre ko results dein.
Taxonomy
Sochiye shikaayaton ko labelled dheriyon mein baantna. Taxonomy categories ka ek naam wala set hai. Chapter 14 mein iska matlab hai aapki woh list ki aapka system kaise fail hota hai, aapke apne shabdon mein, har ek ke saamne ginti ke saath.
1Product ki neev: problem, log aur plan✓

Kisi bhi code se pehle aap product manager ka pehla kaam karte hain. Aap ek problem ka naam rakhte hain. Jinhe woh problem hai, unse baat karte hain. Market kitna bada hai, yeh dekhte hain. Pehle kya karna hai, yeh chunte hain aur use likhte hain. Month 1 mein kuch install nahi karna.

  2. PadhiyeKitaab 1 Chat mein woh number ~13 minEk product manager ko ek hafte ki customer chats mein pehchaan ke numbers milte hain. Use tay karna hai ki yeh ek saal ke kaam ke layak hai ya nahi. Aap seekhte hain ki personal data kya hai. Aap seekhte hain ki faisle se pehle ginti kyun karte hain, problems mein se kaise chunte hain, aur decision kaise likhte hain.

Aur woh ek assumption kaise dhoondhein jise sabse pehle test karna hai.

Woh market ko zameen se upar ki taraf ginti hai. Woh rivals ko parakhti hai, us rival ko bhi jo product nahi hai.

Woh ek chhota pehla target aur success ka ek number chunti hai. Woh product ka naam rakhti hai. Woh kaam ko scores se rank karti hai, aur unhe palatne ko taiyaar rehti hai.

Hum jawaab ko neeche se banate hain: language models, tokens, context window, attention, model kaise banta aur chalta hai, aur do tarah ke AI.
  30. KijiyeA8 Generative AI ki buniyaad: models kaise kaam karte hain ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 12 ghante3 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Teen experiments chalaiye ki models Indian text ke saath kaisa vyavhaar karte hain

Yeh topic poora kijiye

Project stage 1 Tay kijiye ki aap kya bana rahe hain, aur kyon

Code se pehle, aap woh kaam karte hain jo product manager sabse pehle karta hai. Aap problem ka naam rakhte hain aur maujooda tool ko study karte hain. Asli logon se baat karte hain, market ka size nikaalte hain aur strategy chunte hain. Phir kaam plan karte hain aur requirements likhte hain. Saath mein pehle experiments chalate hain. Unse dikhta hai ki AI models Indian text par kaise behave karte hain.

Aur gehraai mein (24)

  • Case Documenting Architecture Decisions Michael Nygard, 2011Woh chhota post jisne software teams mein decision records shuru kiye: context, faisla, nateeje.
  • Case alphagov: the UK government’s code, in the open Government Digital Service, GitHubEk poora sarkari department apna kaam public repositories mein rakhta hai. Koi bhi kholiye aur uske commits ki history padhiye.
  • Case The Four Big Risks Marty Cagan, SVPGValue, usability, feasibility aur viability, unhi ki zubaani jinhone inhe naam diya.
  • Case Quibi WikipediaEk streaming app jisne 1.75 billion dollar jutaye aur saat mahine mein band ho gaya. Bina parkhe value risk ki misaal.
  • Case Know Your Customers’ “Jobs to Be Done” Christensen, Hall, Dillon and Duncan, Harvard Business Review, 2016Milkshake ki kahani aur uske peeche ka idea: log kisi halaat mein aage badhne ke liye product ko “hire” karte hain.
  • Case Excel: Why using Microsoft’s tool caused Covid-19 results to be lost BBC News, 2020Lagbhag 16,000 positive Covid tests gayab ho gaye kyunki ek spreadsheet ki rows khatam ho gayi. Tool ki chhoti seema, asli duniya mein badi keemat.
  • Case How to Miss By a Mile: An Alternative Look at Uber’s Potential Market Size Bill Gurley, 2014Ek investor aur ek professor ne ek hi market ko 25 guna farq se naapa. Top-down banaam bottom-up, khule mein bahas.
  • Case Opportunity Solution Trees Teresa Torres, Product TalkIs chapter wala diagram, use mashhoor karne wali ki zubaani.
  • Case RICE: Simple prioritization for product managers IntercomRICE score kahan se aaya, aur kis team ne use use kiya.
  • Case Performing a Project Premortem Gary Klein, Harvard Business Review, 2007Maan lijiye project fail ho gaya aur likhiye kyun. Is technique par ek page, ise banane wale psychologist se.
  • Case Shape Up Ryan Singer, BasecampKisi ke banane se pehle kaam ko ek tay time box mein dhaalne par ek free kitaab.
  • Case The Illustrated Transformer Jay AlammarWoh diagrams jinse zyadatar engineers ne transformer seekha.
  • Paper The Role of Deliberate Practice in the Acquisition of Expert Performance Ericsson, Krampe and Tesch-Römer, 1993Maharat apni kamzoriyon par nishana lagane wale abhyaas aur feedback se aati hai, sirf ghanton se nahi.
  • Paper Ten Simple Rules for Taking Advantage of Git and GitHub Perez-Riverol et al., PLOS Computational Biology, 2016Researchers apna kaam GitHub par kyun rakhte hain, das chhote niyamon mein. Zyadatar ek product notebook par bhi utne hi laagu hote hain.
  • Paper Why Most Product Launches Fail Schneider and Hall, Harvard Business Review, 2011Naye products ke girne ki paanch baar-baar aane wali wajah, das saal ke launches ke adhyayan se. Zyadatar risks banane se pehle parkhe ja sakte hain.
  • Paper Why You Only Need to Test with 5 Users Jakob Nielsen, Nielsen Norman Group, 2000Paanch users design ki zyadatar usability dikkatein pakad lete hain. Woh curve, aur kab yeh laagu nahi hota.
  • Paper Does High Public Debt Consistently Stifle Economic Growth? Herndon, Ash and Pollin, Cambridge Journal of Economics, 2014Ek student ne ek mashhoor economics paper jaancha aur ek spreadsheet formula pakda jo paanch deshon ko chhod raha tha. Usse nateeja badal gaya.
  • Paper Marketing Malpractice: The Cause and the Cure Christensen, Cook and Hall, Harvard Business Review, 2005Market ko demographics se nahi, us kaam se define kijiye jo customers karwana chahte hain. Zyadatar market sizes galat unit se kyun shuru hote hain.
  • Paper What Is Strategy? Michael Porter, Harvard Business Review, 1996Strategy yeh chunna hai ki kya nahi karna. Woh essay jise har strategy ki baat mein aaj bhi quote kiya jaata hai.
  • Paper Categorizing Variants of Goodhart’s Law Manheim and Garrabrant, 2018Chaar tareeke jinse log jab target ke peeche bhaagte hain toh woh woh naapna band kar deta hai jo aap chahte the. Guardrail metrics isi wajah se hain.
  • Paper Why Johnny Can’t Prompt: How Non-AI Experts Try (and Fail) to Design LLM Prompts Zamfirescu-Pereira et al., CHI 2023Jab AI ke expert na hone wale log prompts se prototype banate hain toh kya hota hai: try karke dekhna, aur ek achhe jawaab ke baad zyada bharosa.
  • Paper Attention Is All You Need Vaswani et al., 2017Woh paper jisne transformer introduce kiya. Introduction padhiye aur Figure 1 dekhiye; maths chhod dijiye.
  • Paper Transformer Explainer: Interactive Learning of Text-Generative Models Cho et al., Georgia Tech, 2024Is chapter mein lage viewer ke peeche ka paper: woh kya dikhata hai aur aise kyun banaya gaya.
  • Paper Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback Ouyang et al., OpenAI, 2022Ek kachcha text predictor assistant kaise bana: instruction tuning aur RLHF, saboot ke saath.

Is topic ke shabd (39)

Artifact
Sochiye ek poora kiya hua homework, jise dost uthakar check kar sake. Artifact woh cheez hai jo aapne banayi aur jise koi doosra khol kar check kar sake: document, spreadsheet, notebook, prototype ya dashboard. Is book mein progress artifacts se gina jaata hai, padhe hue pages se nahi.
Mastery gate
Sochiye saal ke ant ka gate: achhe marks hon tabhi aap aage jaate hain. Mastery gate har chapter ke ant ka check hai. Har artifact ko 0 se 3 tak score dijiye, aur tabhi aage badhiye jab sab kam se kam 2 hon aur safety, privacy ya evidence ka koi item 0 na ho.
Decision log
Sochiye ek diary jismein aap likhte hain ki kya aur kyun chuna, taaki baad mein dekh sakein. Decision log ek chalti file hai jismein har decision ki date, uske peeche ka evidence, aur woh baat likhi jaati hai jo aapko decision badalne par majboor karegi.
Repository
Sochiye ek online folder jo apni files mein kiya har badlaav yaad rakhta hai. Repository GitHub jaisi site par ek folder hai jo project ki files aur unke har purane version ko rakhta hai, har badlaav par ek note ke saath.
Commit
Sochiye document par Save dabana aur saath mein ek chhota note likhna. Commit repository ki files ka ek saved version hai, ek chhote message ke saath ki kya badla.
Formula
Sochiye spreadsheet ke ek khaane mein baitha calculator jo khud ko taaza rakhta hai. Formula spreadsheet ka woh cell hai jo = se shuru hota hai aur doosre cells se apni value nikaalta hai, isliye woh badalta hai jab doosre cells badalte hain.
B2B / B2C
Sochiye thok vyapari jo dukaanon ko bechta hai, aur dukaan jo seedha aapko bechti hai. B2B yaani business-to-business: aap companies ko bechte hain, aur paisa dene wale, use karne wale aur manzoor karne wale aksar alag log hote hain. B2C yaani business-to-consumer: aap individuals ko bechte hain, jo aam taur par khud paisa dete hain aur khud use karte hain.
Product sense
Sochiye ghar banane se pehle chaar cheezein dekhna: koi chahega, koi rah paayega, hum bana paayenge, aur kharcha niklega. Product sense yeh aadat hai ki idea banane se pehle use chaar risks par parkho: value (log chahenge?), usability (log use kar paayenge?), feasibility (hum bana paayenge?) aur viability (business ke liye chalega?).
Jobs to be done
Sochiye ek kaam ke liye taxi kiraye par lena: station time par pahunchna. Jobs to be done ka matlab hai ki log kisi khaas halaat mein aage badhne ke liye product ko "kiraye par lete" hain. Ise aise likhiye: "Jab [halaat], mujhe [chaah] chahiye, taaki main [nateeja] paa sakoon."
Leading question
Sochiye dukaandaar poochhe, "Aapko pasand aaya na?" Leading question woh interview sawaal hai jo us jawaab ki taraf ishara karta hai jo poochhne wala sunna chahta hai, jaise "Kya yeh frustrating nahi hai jab...?" Log aksar haan kah dete hain, isliye aisa jawaab kamzor evidence hai.
Persona
Sochiye poster par ek kalpanik kirdaar jo customers ke poore group ko dikhata hai. Persona ek tarah ke user ka chhota vivaran hai: unke goals, kaam karne ka tareeka aur dikkatein. Yeh tabhi kaam ka hai jab har line asli interviews se judi ho.
Journey map
Sochiye train safar ka naqsha: station, har station par yatri ka mood, aur jhatke wale hisse. Journey map woh steps dikhata hai jinse ek user kaam poora karta hai, har step par woh kya karta, sochta aur mehsoos karta hai, aur dikkat kahan hai.
Riskiest unknown
Sochiye imaarat ki woh ek beam jis par aapko sabse kam bharosa hai. Riskiest unknown woh maani hui baat hai jo galat nikli toh sabse zyaada nuksaan karegi aur jiske baare mein aap sabse kam pakke hain. Ise sabse pehle test kijiye.
TAM / SAM / SOM
Sochiye ek ke andar ek, teen gol: badi thaali, chhoti thaali aur katori. Total addressable market (TAM) har woh insaan hai jise yeh problem hai. Serviceable addressable market (SAM) woh hissa hai jise aap asal mein serve kar sakte hain. Serviceable obtainable market (SOM) woh hai jo aap kuchh saalon mein realistically jeet sakte hain.
Positioning statement
Sochiye dukaan ke board par likhi woh ek line jo batati hai ki dukaan kiske liye hai aur doosron se alag kyun hai. Positioning statement ek ya do vaakya hain jo batate hain ki product kiske liye hai, unke liye kya karta hai, aur mukhya vikalp se alag kaise hai.
Moat
Sochiye kile ke chaaron taraf gehra paani jise dushman aasaani se paar nahi kar sakte. Moat woh fayda hai jise competitors ke liye copy karna mushkil ho, jaise kaam ke flow mein gehra judna, anokha data ya kamaya hua bharosa. Ek prompt ya naya model moat nahi hai.
Opportunity solution tree
Sochiye khandaan ka ped, lekin ideas ka: sabse upar ek goal, neeche needs, phir ideas, phir tests. Opportunity solution tree ek diagram hai jismein sabse upar ek outcome hota hai, uske neeche interviews se mile user ki zarooratein aur dikkatein, phir mumkin solutions, phir tests. Yeh aapko seedha solution par kudne se rokta hai.
Wedge
Sochiye lakdi mein ghuste hue wedge ka patla sira: aage se chhota, lekin baaki ke liye raasta kholta hai. Wedge woh sankra pehla use case hai jise aap saaf taur par jeet sakte hain, aur jise isliye chuna jaata hai ki woh kisi bade kaam tak le jaata hai.
North Star metric
Sochiye dhruv tara jisse naavik raasta dekhte hain: poore crew ke liye ek roshni. North Star metric woh ek number hai jo sabse achhi tarah naapta hai ki customers ko product se kitni value milti hai, jaise "pehle hafte mein pakde gaye issues". Chapter B3 ise detail mein batata hai.
RICE
Sochiye har idea ko uski pahunch, asar aur bharose se number dena, phir mehnat se bhaag dena. RICE ek prioritisation score hai: reach × impact × confidence ÷ effort. Isse aap options ko ek hi tareeke se taul sakte hain, lekin yeh utna hi achha hai jitne achhe andaaze aap daalte hain.
Cost of delay
Sochiye doodh jo fridge ke bahar chhoda ho: jitni der karenge, utna zyaada nuksaan. Cost of delay woh hai jo aap har hafte kho dete hain jab tak koi kaam ruka rehta hai. Jab deadline ho, jaise contract renewal, tab yeh bahut zyaada hota hai.
Outcome roadmap
Sochiye teen columns wala notice board: abhi, agla aur baad mein. Outcome roadmap in teen columns mein banaya roadmap hai jahan har item ek nateeja hai jo aap chahte hain, kisi date wali feature nahi.
Kill criterion
Sochiye match shuru hone se pehle tay kar lena ki ek ghante baarish hui toh khel rok denge. Kill criterion woh nateeja hai, pehle se tay kiya hua, jiska matlab hai ki ab us kaam par kaam rok do. Jaise: "agar chaar hafte mein aadhe se kam design partners alert par kuchh karte hain, toh ruk jao".
OKRs
Sochiye school ka goal, "maths mein achha karna", aur marks jo dikhate hain ki kar liya. OKRs yaani objectives aur key results. Objective shabdon mein batata hai ki aap kya chahte hain; 3 se 4 key results woh number hain jo dikhate hain ki aap wahan pahunche. Key results outcomes hone chahiye, outputs nahi.
Guardrail metric
Sochiye pul ki railing: aap tez bhaagte hain, phir bhi woh aapko surakshit rakhti hai. Guardrail metric woh number hai jo goal ke peechhe bhaagte waqt kharab nahi hona chahiye, jaise false-alarm rate ya cost per customer. Yeh team ko aisa target chhoone se rokta hai jisse users ko nuksaan ho.
Stakeholder map
Sochiye shaadi ka seating chart: kaun stage ke paas baithega aur kaun peechhe. Stakeholder map faisle se jude logon ka grid hai, jinhe is hisaab se rakha jaata hai ki unka kitna asar hai aur unhe kitni parwaah hai. Yeh dikhata hai ki kiske saath nazdeek se kaam karna hai aur kaun veto kar sakta hai.
Pre-mortem
Sochiye operation se pehle doctor ka likhna ki woh kaise bigad sakta hai. Pre-mortem ka matlab hai: shuru karne se pehle maan lijiye ki project fail ho gaya, aur likhiye kyun. Isse woh risks saamne aate hain jo log chalte hue plan ke baare mein nahi uthate.
PRD
Sochiye kisi pakwaan ka recipe card: woh kya hai, kiske liye hai, aur kaise pata chalega ki sahi bana. PRD (product requirements document) batata hai ki kya banana hai, kiske liye aur kyun, problem aur uske evidence se shuru karke. Chapter 18 AI wala version batata hai.
User story
Sochiye wish card ki ek line: ek insaan kya chahta hai aur kyun. User story user ki nazar se value ka ek tukda hai: "[role] ke roop mein, main [kaam] chahta hoon, taaki [fayda] ho." Har story ko acceptance criteria aur edge cases chahiye.
MVP
Sochiye khaane ka thela jo aap restaurant banane se pehle kholte hain. MVP (minimum viable product) sabse chhoti cheez hai jo asli users ke saath aapki sabse risky maani hui baat ko test kare. Yeh poore product ka chhota version nahi hai.
Vertical slice
Sochiye parat wale cake ka patla tukda kaatna, taaki har parat ek saath chakh sakein. Vertical slice kisi feature ka patla version hai jo har layer se guzarta hai, input se user ki value tak, taaki asli user use jaldi aazma sake.
Time-box
Sochiye anishchit pakwaan ke liye lagaya kitchen timer. Time-box anishchit kaam ke liye tay kiya hua samay hai, ek aisa nateeja jo safalta ginega, aur ek plan agar aap wahan nahi pahunche.
Usability test
Sochiye kisi ko naya tiffin box kholte hue dekhna, bina madad kiye. Usability test ka matlab hai ek asli user ko aapke product se kaam poora karte dekhna, bina madad kiye, taaki dikhe ki woh kahan atakta hai.
Transformer
Sochiye ek paathak jo poora page ek saath dekhta hai aur chunta hai ki pehle ke kaun se shabd sabse zaroori hain. Transformer aaj ke LLMs ke peechhe ka model design hai. Yeh context ka har token ek saath padhta hai aur seekhta hai ki agla token guess karne ke liye pehle ke kaun se tokens zaroori hain.
Inference
Sochiye woh student jo exam de raha hai, padh nahi raha. Inference ka matlab hai trained model chalakar jawaab lena. Training model ko badalti hai; inference sirf use karti hai. Aapke bill ka zyaadatar hissa inference ka hota hai.
Pre-training
Sochiye ek bachcha jo school jaane se pehle poori library padh leta hai. Pre-training pehla aur sabse mehenga training stage hai: model bahut saare text par agla token guess karna seekhta hai.
Instruction tuning
Sochiye tota jo ek chhoti class mein jaata hai jahan woh sawaalon ka jawaab dena seekhta hai, bas bolte rehna nahi. Instruction tuning pre-training ke baad ki training hai, jismein instructions aur achhe jawaabon ke examples hote hain, taaki model request maane, sirf text aage na badhaye.
RLHF
Sochiye teacher jo do jawaabon mein se behtar par nishaan lagata hai, aur student un nishaanon se seekhta hai. RLHF yaani reinforcement learning from human feedback. Log model ke jawaabon ko rank karte hain, aur model ko unke pasand ke jawaabon ki taraf train kiya jaata hai.
Open-weight model
Sochiye recipe ki kitaab jo aap ghar le jaakar apni rasoi mein bana sakte hain, restaurant se mangwane ke bajaye. Open-weight model woh hai jiske trained weights chhape hue hain, taaki aap use khud download karke chala sakein, vendor ki API ko call karne ke bajaye.
2Machine se milna: tokens, pehli call, yaadasht aur instructions✓

Aap apne hi text par ek model se milte hain. Python ki kuch lines padhna seekhte hain. Ek free model connect karte hain, pehli call bhejte hain aur uska bill padhte hain. Phir dekhte hain ki model bhoolta kyun hai, aur instructions uske jawaab kaise badalte hain.

Yeh topic poora kijiye

Project stage 2 Pehla samparka: Bharatiya text ke saath AI model kya karta hai?

Aap ready-made AI models ko starter sentences par try karte hain. Aap dekhte hain ki text chhote tukdon (tokens, Lego ki eent jaise) mein kaise kata jaata hai aur ek check ki cost kitni aati hai. Phir aap seekhte hain ki saaf instructions kaise likhein jisse model personal details dhoondh le.

Is topic ke ant tak aapke paas hoga

Extras, sirf agar chahein

Kis par tika hai

Kisi pichhle topic se kuch nahi.

Aur gehraai mein (19)

  • Case Tokenizer OpenAIEk vendor ka apna tool: text paste kijiye aur dekhiye ki woh kin tokens ka bill banata hai. Ek Hindi sentence uske English wale ke saath try kijiye.
  • Case Why Jupyter is data scientists’ computational notebook of choice Jeffrey Perkel, Nature, 2018Scientists notebooks mein kaise kaam karte hain, bilkul in pages jaise: code ke chhote cells, ek-ek karke chalaaye hue, aur har ek ka result theek uske neeche.
  • Case The OpenAI Python library OpenAI, on GitHubChapter 1 ke model call ke peeche yahi library hai. Iska pehla example wahi shape rakhta hai jo aapne padhna seekha: ek client, named settings wala create call, aur dots se jawab tak ka raasta.
  • Case Mata v. Avianca, Inc. WikipediaVakeelon ne ek brief mein chhah aise cases daale jo chatbot ne bana diye the, aur jurmana bhara. Fluent hona sach hona nahi.
  • Case Context Rot: how increasing input tokens impacts LLM performance Chroma research, 2025Atharah models, aasaan tasks, lambe se lambe inputs: har ek kam bharosemand hua. Context chhota rakhne ka naapa hua tark.
  • Case Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149 BC Civil Resolution Tribunal, 2024Ek airline ke chatbot ne refund ka niyam khud bana diya aur airline ko use maanna pada. Chatbot jo kehta hai uski zimmedaari company ki hai.
  • Case Prompt engineering overview Anthropic, Claude docsEk model vendor apne customers ko prompts likhna kaise sikhata hai: saaf instructions, examples, sochne ki jagah, structure.
  • Paper Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units Sennrich, Haddow and Birch, 2015Byte-pair encoding, woh tareeka jisse zyadatar models text ko tokens mein kaat-te hain.
  • Paper Language Model Tokenizers Introduce Unfairness Between Languages Petrov et al., 2023Wahi sentence kuch bhashaon mein kai guna zyada tokens leta hai, Bharatiya bhashayein bhi. Yeh aapne Experiment 1 mein naapa.
  • Paper The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration Holtzman et al., 2019Hamesha sabse sambhavit agla word chunna bura kyun padhta hai, aur temperature aur top-p jaisi settings ise kaise theek karti hain.
  • Paper Ten quick tips for teaching programming Neil Brown and Greg Wilson, PLOS Computational Biology, 2018Code seekhne ke baare mein research kya kehti hai. Apna code likhne se pehle bane-banaaye examples padhna aur line-by-line follow karna iski ek tip hai, aur yeh chapter usi par bana hai.
  • Paper Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3) Brown et al., 2020Dikhaya ki ek bada model prompt mein kuch examples dekh kar kai kaam kar sakta hai, isiliye prompting ek kaam ban gaya.
  • Paper On the Opportunities and Risks of Foundation Models Bommasani et al., Stanford, 2021Woh lambi report jisne “foundation models” naam diya. Badi tasveer ke liye introduction padhiye.
  • Paper Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts Liu et al., 2023Models lambe prompt ki shuruaat aur aakhir ko beech se behtar use karte hain. Page 1 ka chart hi poora sabak hai.
  • Paper MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems Packer et al., 2023Yaaddasht application ka kaam hai: prompt mein kya rakhein, kya bahar karein, kya wapas laayein.
  • Paper Why Language Models Hallucinate Kalai, Nachum, Vempala and Zhang, OpenAI, 2025Models andaaza lagate hain kyunki tests “mujhe nahi pata” se zyada andaaze ko inaam dete hain. Hallucination aam vyavhaar kyun hai, saaf samjhaya.
  • Paper Survey of Hallucination in Natural Language Generation Ji et al., 2022Banaye hue output ki kismein, unhe kaise naapte hain, aur unhe kya kam karta hai.
  • Paper Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models Wei et al., 2022Examples mein steps dikhane se models kai-step wale sawaalon mein behtar hue. “Step by step socho” ki shuruaat.
  • Paper The Prompt Report: A Systematic Survey of Prompting Techniques Schulhoff et al., 2024Atthawan prompting techniques, naam aur tulna ke saath. Ise reference ki tarah use kijiye, poora padhne ke liye nahi.

Is topic ke shabd (14)

Model / LLM
Model (LLM) ek aise tote jaisa hai jisne poori library padh li ho. Yeh ek prediction machine hai jise bahut saare text par train kiya gaya hai. Yeh text ko aise aage badhata hai jo sunne mein sahi lage, aur kuchh look up nahi karta.
API call
Sochiye ek SMS jisme kuchh paise lagte hain: ek message jaata hai, ek reply aata hai, aur aap ek baar paisa dete hain. API call mein aapka app model ke servers ko request bhejta hai aur reply ka intezaar karta hai.
Token
Sochiye text ki ek Lego eent. Token word ka ek chhota tukda hai, aur model isi unit mein padhta, likhta aur bill banata hai. Ek token lagbhag ek English word ka ¾ hota hai.
Context window
Sochiye model ki mez: jo mez par fit ho wahi ek baar mein padha ja sakta hai. Context window woh sabse zyaada text hai jo model ek request mein sambhal sakta hai, jismein jo andar jaata hai aur jo bahar aata hai, dono ek saath ginte jaate hain.
Stateless
Sochiye goldfish: har message ke baad sab bhool jaati hai, jab tak aap purani chat dobara na bhejein. Stateless ka matlab hai ki model requests ke beech kuchh yaad nahi rakhta. Model ki taraf se har request saaf slate se shuru hoti hai.
usage
Sochiye har reply ke saath aane wala bill. Usage block ek request ki receipt hai. Isme dikhta hai ki kitne prompt tokens andar padhe gaye aur kitne completion tokens bahar likhe gaye.
System prompt
Sochiye dukaan ki deewar par lage niyam, jo har order se pehle padhe jaate hain. System prompt ek tay nirdesh hai jo har message ke saath jaata hai, user ki nazar se door. Yeh AI ko batata hai ki kaise pesh aana hai.
Temperature
Sochiye model apne agle word mein kitna jokhim leta hai. Temperature ek setting hai jo tay karti hai ki AI hamesha apna sabse mumkin agla guess chune (safe khele) ya kabhi kam mumkin wala chune (jokhim le). Kam setting se baar-baar ek jaise jawaab milte hain. Isse woh sach nahi ho jaate.
Hallucination
Sochiye pakke yakeen se boli gayi banawati baat: ek gadha hua jawaab seedhe chehre ke saath. Hallucination tab hota hai jab AI aisi cheez deta hai jo saaf-suthri sunayi deti hai lekin banawati hai, kyunki uske paas koi evidence nahi tha. Yeh kharabi nahi hai. Jab guess karne wali machine ke paas kuchh nahi hota, woh aam taur par aise hi karti hai.
Guardrail
Sochiye pul ki railing: yeh girne se rokti hai, gaadi nahi chalati. Guardrail woh har cheez hai jo nuksaandeh ya galat outputs ko kam kare. Sabse saral prakar system prompt mein ek vaakya hai.
Prompt
Sochiye woh parchi jo aap model ko dete hain: aap kya chahte hain, aur kaise. Prompt woh text hai jo aapka app model ko bhejta hai: user ka sawaal aur saath jude tay nirdesh. Yeh zyaadatar aam English hai, koi jaadui vaakya nahi.
Variable
Sochiye label laga dabba jisme ek cheez rakhi ho. Variable ek naam hai jo ek value rakhta hai, taaki code ki aage ki lines use istemal kar sakein. city = "Pune" mein naam city variable hai. Barabar ke nishaan ko "ab hai" padhiye.
Dictionary
Sochiye phone book: naam dekho, value pao. Python mein dictionary label aur value ki jodiyan hain curly braces ke andar, ek chhote form jaisi: {"role": "user", "content": "hello"}. Model ko bheja har message isi tarah likha jaata hai.
Few-shot
Sochiye naye rasoiye ko pakane se pehle do-teen bane hue pakwaan dikhana. Few-shot ka matlab hai prompt ke andar kaam ke do ya teen hal kiye examples rakhna, taaki model unka dhancha copy kare. Zero-shot ka matlab hai bina kisi example ke poochhna.
3Use parakhna, aur pehle kaam: chhaantna aur saar likhna✓

Model par bharosa karne se pehle aap ek answer key banate hain, jaise teacher ki key, jisse use jaancha ja sake. Phir model ko pehle do kaam dete hain: messages ko groups mein chhaantna, aur unka saar likhna.

Is topic ke shabd (1)

Eval

Aur gehraai mein (9)

  • Paper Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space (word2vec) Mikolov et al., 2013“king − man + woman ≈ queen” kahan se aaya: words ek meaning-map par points ki tarah.
  • Paper Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks Reimers and Gurevych, 2019Poore sentences ko kaam ke embeddings kaise mile, jisse semantic search kaam ka bana.

Is topic ke shabd (17)

Chunk
Sochiye lambi kitaab se kaata gaya ek index card. Chunk ek document ka woh tukda hai jo kaatne ke baad bana. Yahi woh unit hai jo store hota hai, search hota hai aur model ko bheja jaata hai.
Chunking
Sochiye lambi kitaab ko index cards mein kaatna. Chunking khud yeh kaatne ka kaam hai. Yeh ek ubaau kaam lagta hai, lekin yeh ek asli design decision hai.
Fixed-size chunking
Sochiye kapde ke thaan ko har meter par kaatna, design chahe kuchh bhi ho. Fixed-size chunking har N words ke baad kaatna hai, text ka matlab chahe kuchh bhi ho.
Semantic chunking
Sochiye kitaab ko uske chapter ke ant par kaatna, page ke beech mein nahi. Semantic chunking wahan kaatna hai jahan document ka apna dhancha use baantta hai.
Chunk overlap
Sochiye ek page ki aakhri line ka agle page ke upar dobara chhapna. Chunk overlap ek chunk ki aakhri lines ko agle chunk ke shuru mein dohrana hai. Isse jo jawaab do chunks ki seema par ho, woh kho nahi jaata.
Retrieval
Sochiye open-book exam: pehle sahi page dhoondhiye. Retrieval sabhi stored chunks mein se woh thode chunks laana hai jo sawaal ka jawaab dene ke sabse kareeb hon.
Keyword search
Sochiye Ctrl+F: yeh aapka likha hua ekdum wahi word dhoondhta hai. Keyword search text ko un words se dhoondhta hai jo sawaal ke saath milte hain. Yeh spelling milata hai aur matlab ke liye andha hai.
Query
Sochiye woh parchi jo aap librarian ko dete hain jis par aapka sawaal likha hai. Query woh sawaal hai jo andar aata hai.
Hybrid search
Sochiye do madadgaaron se poochhna, ek jo ekdum wahi words milata hai aur ek jo matlab milata hai, phir dono ki list milana. Hybrid search keyword search aur semantic search ko saath chalata hai, phir unke results milata hai.
Top-k
Sochiye merit list se sirf upar ke k students chunna. Top-k ka matlab hai sirf sabse achhe k results lena. Number k ek ghumaane wala dial hai recall (kuchh na chhootna) aur precision (kachra na uthana) ke beech.
Embedding
Sochiye matlab ka pata: jin vaakyon ka matlab ek jaisa hai, woh ek hi gali mein rehte hain. Embedding woh jagah hai jo text ko matlab ke naqshe par milti hai, numbers ki list ke roop mein likhi hui. Ise ek chhota AI banata hai jiska ek hi kaam text ko jagah dena hai.
Embedding model
Sochiye naqshanavis jo har vaakya ko uska pata deta hai. Embedding model text padhta hai aur matlab ke naqshe par uska pata wapas deta hai.
Cosine similarity
Sochiye matlab ke naqshe par do gharon ki doori naapna. Cosine similarity do text tukdon ke kareeb hone ki jaldi jaanch hai. Number jitna zyaada, matlab mein woh utne kareeb.
Semantic search
Sochiye kisi ghar ko matlab ke naqshe par uske pate se dhoondhna, naam kaisa dikhta hai us se nahi. Semantic search text ko matlab ke naqshe par uske pate se dhoondhta hai, spelling se nahi.
query vs. passage
Sochiye chitthi par chipka sticker jis par "sawaal" ya "kitaab ka page" likha ho. Query vs. passage ek label hai jo aap embedding banate waqt dete hain, jo batata hai ki text sawaal hai ya document ka tukda. Agar aap ise chhod dein, toh quality chupchaap girti hai aur koi chetavani nahi aati.
Vector database
Sochiye pate ke cards ki bahut badi almari jo tezi se aapke card ke sabse paas wale dhoondh leti hai. Vector database ek system hai jo embeddings store karta hai aur kisi diye hue ke sabse paas wale tezi se dhoondh sakta hai.
Vector
Sochiye matlab ke naqshe par ghar ka number, numbers ki ek line ke roop mein. Vector numbers ki ek list hai. Jab yeh course kehta hai ki text ki matlab ke naqshe par "jagah" hai, toh woh jagah ek vector hai: kuchh sau numbers jo batate hain ki woh kahan baitha hai. Aap unhe kabhi nahi dekhte.

Is topic ke shabd (7)

Evaluation
Sochiye teacher jo aapki copy ko answer key se milakar number deta hai. Evaluation aapke system ko un jawaabon se milakar parakhna hai jo aap pehle se check kar chuke hain. Yeh acceptance testing jaisa hai, lekin AI ke liye.
Ground truth
Sochiye teacher ki answer key: sahi jawaabon wale sawaal, test se pehle likhe hue. Ground truth sawaalon ka ek set hai jinke sahi jawaab jaanche hue hain, aur jo aapke kuchh bhi test karne se pehle likhe jaate hain. Iske bina "kya yeh achha hai?" ka koi jawaab nahi.
Recall
Sochiye talaab mein jaal: talaab ki saari machhliyon mein se aapke jaal ne kitni pakdi? Recall hai ki jo kuchh mayne rakhta tha, usmein se aapne kitna laaya. Kam recall ka matlab hai ki aapse files chhoot gayin.
Precision
Phir jaal sochiye: jo aapke jaal mein hai, usmein kitna asal machhli hai? Precision hai ki jo aap laaye, usmein se kitna mayne rakhta tha. Kam precision ka matlab hai kaagzon mein dabi mez.
Acceptance criteria
Sochiye pass hone ke woh marks jo aap aur teacher exam se pehle tay karte hain. Acceptance criteria woh numbers aur vyavhaar hain jo aap pehle se tay karte hain, jinhe system ko live hone se pehle poora karna hota hai.
RAG
Sochiye open-book exam: pehle sahi page dhoondho, phir usi se jawaab do. RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) ka matlab hai ki aap pehle jaanche hue text ko retrieve karte hain, phir model usi text se apna jawaab likhta hai.
Rubric
Sochiye marking scheme jo teacher copiyan check karne se pehle likhta hai, taaki do teacher ek jaise number dein. Rubric pehle se likhi hui scoring guide hai: gunvatta ke har star ka kya matlab hai, taaki ek hi cheez grade karne wale do log sehmat hon.
6Bharosemand jawaab, tools, context, sochna aur intezaar✓

Asli product ko tay shape mein jawaab chahiye. Use aisa model chahiye jo tools chala sake, aur uske saamne sahi text. Aap thinking models se bhi milte hain, aur un seconds ke liye design karte hain jab user intezaar karta hai.

Aapke steps, kram se

Phir bhi khaane mein galat jawaab aa sakta hai, isliye form aisa banate hain ki invent karne ki jagah na bache.

  6. PadhiyeKitaab 20 Machine ko haath dena ~9 min12 digits ka order number Aadhaar number jaisa dikh sakta hai. Check-digit rule zyadatar look-alikes hata deta hai. Dekhte hain ki loop ki cost kaise badhti hai, aur padhne wale actions aur karne wale actions mein kya fark hai.

Aap context engineering, token budgets, caching aur compaction se milte hain.

Is chapter mein reasoning models, sochne ki cost, latency, streaming, aur ek aisa design hai jisme mehnga, dhyaan se judge karne wala kabhi customer ko intezaar nahi karwata.

  • Paper DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning DeepSeek-AI, 2025Ek open model jisne reinforcement learning se reason karna seekha, tareeka publish karke.
  • Paper Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally can be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters Snell et al., 2024Kab chhote model ko zyada der sochne dena bade model se sasta padta hai.
  • Paper Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding Leviathan, Kalman and Matias, Google, 2022Chhota model draft karta hai, bada jaanchta hai: providers ka wahi jawaab jaldi pahunchane ka ek tareeka.

Is topic ke shabd (23)

Schema
Sochiye fixed khaanon wala form. Schema us aakar ka ek pakka vivaran hai jo output ka hona chahiye: usmein kaun se fields hain, unke types kya hain, aur kaun se zaroori hain.
Structured output
Sochiye model chitthi likhne ke bajaye form bhar raha hai. Structured output woh model output hai jo schema ke andar bandha ho, khuli-khuli likhai ke bajaye.
Constrained decoding
Sochiye keyboard jo sirf wahi keys dabane deta hai jo form mein fit hon. Constrained decoding mein har step par model ko sirf woh tokens chunne diye jaate hain jo schema mein fit hon. Isse galat output sirf kam sambhav nahi hota, namumkin ho jaata hai.
Enum
Sochiye dropdown menu: aap sirf list mein se hi chun sakte hain. Enum ek field hai jo sirf ek tay list mein se hi value rakh sakta hai.
Refusal path
Sochiye woh clerk jo kuchh gadhne ke bajaye kehta hai "main bata nahi sakta". Refusal path woh hai jo product tab karta hai jab use jawaab nahi dena chahiye. Yeh "tay nahi kar sakte" kehne ka ek structured tareeka deta hai, kuchh gadhne ke bajaye. Ise aap jaan-boojhkar banate hain, warna yeh ittefaq se hota hai.
Validation loop
Sochiye teacher jo galat form wapas deta hai, galti par gola lagakar. Validation loop ka matlab hai: output ko parse karo, validate karo, aur agar fail ho toh error saath lagakar dobara poochho.
Tool / function calling
Sochiye model dukaandaar se kehta hai ki zara stock check kar do. Tool calling (function calling) mein aap un functions ka vivaran dete hain jo call ho sakte hain, taaki model unmein se ek chalwane ko keh sake, likhe hue jawaab ke bajaye.
Agent loop
Sochiye madadgaar jo errands par baar-baar jaata hai: poochho, karo, batao, dohrao. Agent loop tab hai jab model ek tool maangta hai, aapka code use chalata hai, nateeja model ko wapas jaata hai, aur yeh dohraya jaata hai.
Step budget
Sochiye madadgaar ka curfew: dus baje tak ghar aa jao. Step budget is baat ki kadi seema hai ki loop kitni baar chal sakta hai. Yeh vaikalpik nahi hai.
Trace
Sochiye madadgaar ka liya hua raasta, sirf yeh nahi ki woh kahan pahuncha. Trace ek run ke steps, calls, arguments aur results ki record ki hui list hai.
Side-effect boundary
Sochiye dukaan ki khidki se dekhne aur maal hilane mein farq. Side-effect boundary woh rekha hai jo sirf padhne wale tools ko un tools se alag karti hai jo duniya mein kuchh badal dete hain.
Context engineering
Sochiye model ki mez sajana: kya rakhna hai, kis kram mein, aur kya hata dena hai. Context engineering tay karna hai ki context window (lifaafe) mein kya jaaye, kis kram mein, aur kya bahar dhakela jaaye. Yeh andar ke samaan ke baare mein hai, is baare mein nahi ki prompt kaise likha gaya.
Context rot
Sochiye itni bhari mez ki jo cheezein saamne hain woh bhi chhootne lagti hain. Context rot tab hota hai jab context badhne par model use kam achhe se istemal karta hai, limit tak pahunchne se bahut pehle.
Lost in the middle
Sochiye lambi film ka shuru aur ant yaad rehna lekin beech ka nahi. Lost in the middle ka matlab hai ki model shuru aur ant ki cheezein beech ki cheezon se kahin zyaada bharosemand tareeke se dhoondhta hai.
Prompt caching
Sochiye dukaandaar jo aapka roz ka order jaanta hai aur seedha shuru kar deta hai. Prompt caching ka matlab hai ki provider request ke shuru ka woh hissa dobara kaam mein leta hai jo woh pehle hi process kar chuka hai. Na badalne wale hisse pehle rakhiye aur badalne wale baad mein.
Compaction
Sochiye copy ke purane pages ko chhote saar mein sametna taaki likhne ki jagah bane, aur sabse naya page jaisa hai waisa rakhna. Compaction purane context ka saar banakar budget khaali karna hai, jabki sabse naya hissa shabd-ba-shabd rakha jaata hai.
Reasoning model
Sochiye student jo final jawaab likhne se pehle kachche kaagaz par hisaab karta hai. Reasoning model jawaab dene se pehle apna kuchh hisaab khud karta hai. Yeh dheema hai, aur kabhi-kabhi behtar.
Test-time compute
Sochiye exam ke dauraan student ko har sawaal par zyaada samay dena, school ke zyaada saal dene ke bajaye. Test-time compute ka matlab hai ki model chalte waqt har query par zyaada sahi jawaab ke liye paisa dena, training ke dauraan dene ke bajaye.
Thinking budget
Sochiye student ko kachche kaagaz ke kitne panne milte hain. Thinking budget woh setting hai jo tay karti hai ki model ko kitna hisaab karne ki ijaazat hai. Ise tay karna ek product decision hai.
p50 / p95 latency
Sochiye chai ka intezaar: beech wale customer ka intezaar, aur peechhe ke kuchh bad-kismat logon ka intezaar. p50 latency madhyak response time hai; p95 latency dheemi poonchh ka response time hai. Users poonchh ko mehsoos karte hain.
JSON schema
Sochiye fixed khaanon wala form, jiska vivaran likha ho. JSON schema is baat ka likha vivaran hai ki JSON ke ek tukde ka theek kya aakar hona chahiye: kaun se fields, kis type ke, aur kaun se zaroori. Ek program har jawaab ko isse milakar dekhta hai.
TTFT (time to first token)
Sochiye, chai-wala ke dhaar shuru karne se pehle ka intezaar. TTFT yeh hai ki request bhejne ke kitni der baad jawaab ka pehla shabd aata hai. Lamba prompt ho to yeh badhta hai, kyunki model ko pehle poora padhna padta hai.
TPOT (time per output token)
Sochiye, chai-wala shuru karne ke baad kitni tezi se dhaar daalta hai. TPOT jawaab ke ek shabd aur agle shabd ke beech ka ausat samay hai. Tools ise inter-token latency (ITL) bhi kehte hain.
7Behtar search, hamle, aur bahut saare jawaabon ki grading✓

Aap search ko behtar banate hain. Phir apne hi system par waise hamla karte hain jaise koi anjaan karega. Phir code aur model se ek saath bahut saare jawaab grade karte hain, aur galtiyan haath se padhte hain.

Aapke steps, kram se

  1. Week 14 · Sochne wale models, intezaar, aur behtar search 18 Jan – 24 Jan
  2. PadhiyeKitaab 23 Search ko behtar banana ~8 minEk customer ko pichhle saal ki late fee bata di jaati hai. Search ko behtar karne ke chaar tareeke ek hi answer key par naape jaate hain. Sabse saada tareeka hi akela hai jo result ka vaada kar sakta hai. Chapter mein hybrid search, reranking, contextual retrieval, metadata filtering aur agentic search aate hain.
  3. Kijiye12 Behtar retrieval: hybrid search, reranking, context aur filters ~1.5 ghante5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Dhoondhna behtar banaiye, ek-ek change karke
  4. ParakhiyePeechhe dekhiye: Week 14 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, aur kya nahi.
  5. Week 15 · Jab page hukm de, aur bade paimaane par grading 25 Jan – 31 Jan
  6. PadhiyeKitaab 24 Jab page hukm dene lage ~8 minGuard ajnabiyon ka likha padhta hai, isliye woh building ka sabse khula hua program hai. Team ek model ko ajnabi ki baat maante dekhti hai. Phir woh seekhti hai ki chance kam karne wali defence aur power hata dene wali defence mein kya farq hai. Is chapter mein prompt injection aur lethal trifecta aate hain.
  7. Kijiye13 Prompt injection: jab aapke documents hukum dene lagte hain ~55 min5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Apne tool ko prompt injection (text mein chhupe hukum) ke liye jaanchiye
  8. PadhiyeKitaab 25 Hazaar jawaabon ko marks dena ~8 minHaath se check karna lagbhag 50 jawaabon par kaam karna band kar deta hai. Is chapter mein jawaab ko marks dene ke teen tareeke hain, aisi model ko kaise test karein jo doosri models ko grade karti hai, aur error analysis. Yeh field ka sabse kaam ka quality-work hai, aur ismein kisi machine ki zaroorat nahi.
  9. Kijiye14 Evaluation scale par: code checks aur LLM judges ~65 min4 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Ek automatic marker banaiye, aur check kijiye ki us par kitna bharosa karein
  10. Kijiye14.5 Error analysis: failures ko haath se padhna ~75 min1 hands-on exercise · Project ka kaam: Tees asli outputs padhiye, aur naam dijiye ki tool kin tareekon se fail hota hai
  11. AazmaiyeTry Post: maine apne hi tool par hamla kiya ~20 minChhoti publish recipe follow kijiye. Teen vaakya likhiye. Pehla, apne hi tool par hamla karne par kya hua. Doosra, aapke judge ka agreement figure. Teesra, ek link. Bataiye ki aapne kya badla. Sirf banaya hua data use kijiye.
  12. ParakhiyePeechhe dekhiye: Week 15 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, aur kya nahi.

Yeh topic poora kijiye

Project stage 7 Ise behtar banaiye, phir ispar hamla kijiye

Aap tool ko ek-ek change karke behtar banate hain aur har change measure karte hain. Phir use todne ki koshish karte hain. Kya text mein chhupa ek sentence AI ko orders de sakta hai? Aap tool ka kaam check karne ke liye ek automatic marker banate hain (ek doosra student jo homework check karta hai). Aur 100 asli outputs haath se padhte hain, yeh jaanne ke liye ki kya galat hota hai.

Is topic ke ant tak aapke paas hoga

Extras, sirf agar chahein

Kis par tika hai

  • Aapki retrieval (finder) sabse saada waali thi jo kaam karti hai 7.5 se, Topic 5 Aapne Chapter 7.5 mein iski limit dekhi thi. Yeh chapter use behtar banata hai.
  • Keyword search aur meaning search alag-alag tarah se fail hote hain 5 se, Topic 4 Ek meaning chhod deta hai. Doosra exact shabd chhod deta hai.
  • Zyada chunks laane par aise chunks bhi zyada aate hain jo kaam ke nahi 6 se, Topic 5 Yeh lena-dena aapne Chapter 6 mein dekha tha.
  • Aapke documents ka text model ko hukum de sakta hai 7.5 se, Topic 5 Yeh Chapter 7.5 ki chauthi kami hai. Isi ka koi poora ilaaj nahi hai.
  • Guardrail bhi bas likha hua hukum hai 2 se, Topic 2 Aapne Chapter 2 mein ek likha tha. Phir aapne use tod diya tha.
  • Laaya hua text message mein jaata hai 3 se, Topic 4 Aapke documents mein jo bhi hai, woh message ka hissa banke model tak pahunchta hai.
  • Tools model ko kaam karne dete hain 9 se, Topic 6 Padhna undo ho sakta hai. Bhejna, paise dena aur delete karna undo nahi hota.
  • Aapne jawaab pehle likh liye the 6 se, Topic 5 Das sawaal aur unke sahi jawaab, testing se pehle likhe hue. Yahi aapki teacher wali answer key hai.
  • Test karne se pehle answer key likhiye 6 se, Topic 5 Yeh wahi idea hai, bas sawaalon ki jagah failures par.

Aur gehraai mein (14)

  • Case Introducing Contextual Retrieval Anthropic, 2024Har chunk mein ek line context, saath mein keyword search aur reranking, se galat retrievals do-tihaai tak kam hue. Numbers ke saath.
  • Case Prompt injection attacks against GPT-3 Simon Willison, 2022Woh post jisne prompt injection ko naam diya, pehle public demos ke kuch hi din baad likha gaya.
  • Case The lethal trifecta for AI agents Simon Willison, 2025Private data, bharose se bahar ka content aur data bahar bhejne ka raasta: teeno wala koi bhi agent leak karwaya ja sakta hai.
  • Case Your AI Product Needs Evals Hamel Husain, 2024Ek real estate assistant (Rechat) tests banakar, traces padh kar aur sabse badi failure pehle theek karke kaise aage badha.
  • Case A field guide to rapidly improving AI products Hamel Husain, 2025Apna data dekhiye, ek simple viewer banaiye, failure ki kismein giniye, phir theek kijiye. Sabse tez sudharne wali teams ki aadatein.
  • Paper Reciprocal Rank Fusion outperforms Condorcet and individual Rank Learning Methods Cormack, Clarke and Büttcher, SIGIR 2009Do pages jinse woh fusion formula mila jo aapne is chapter mein likha.
  • Paper Passage Re-ranking with BERT Nogueira and Cho, 2019Ek chhoti list ko taakatwar model se dobara rank karna: ek seedhe idea se standard benchmark par badi chhalaang.
  • Paper Not what you’ve signed up for: Compromising Real-World LLM-Integrated Applications with Indirect Prompt Injection Greshake et al., 2023Web page ya document mein chhupi instructions use padhne wale assistant par kabza kar leti hain. Indirect injection ko naam dene wala paper.
  • Paper Ignore Previous Prompt: Attack Techniques For Language Models Perez and Ribeiro, 2022Goal hijacking aur prompt leaking, ek production model par naape hue.
  • Paper Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena Zheng et al., 2023Jab ek model doosre ko grade karta hai toh woh logon se utna hi sehmat hota hai jitna log aapas mein, aur uske biases naape ja sakte hain.
  • Paper G-Eval: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment Liu et al., 2023Score dene se pehle apne steps likhne wala judge logon se zyada sehmat raha. Rubric prompts ke liye ek template.
  • Paper Large Language Models are not Fair Evaluators Wang et al., 2023Do jawaabon ka order badliye aur judge ka faisla aksar palat jaata hai. Position bias, naapa hua.
  • Paper Who Validates the Validators? Aligning LLM-Assisted Evaluation with Human Preferences Shankar et al., 2024Outputs padhte-padhte aapke grading criteria badalte hain. Judge ko aapke apne marks se kyun jaanchna chahiye.
  • Paper Errudite: Scalable, Reproducible, and Testable Error Analysis Wu, Ribeiro, Heer and Weld, ACL 2019Bees failures padhna aapko kyun bhatka sakta hai, aur iski jagah error groups ko kaise define, ginein aur test karein.

Is topic ke shabd (24)

BM25
Sochiye Ctrl+F jo durlabh words ko aam words se zyaada keemti maanta hai. BM25 keyword matches ko rank karne ka ek aankdon wala tareeka hai jo durlabh words ko zyaada vazan deta hai. Yeh Chapter 4 ka scoreboard hai, theek se banaya hua.
Reciprocal rank fusion
Sochiye do judge jo apni-apni rank list dete hain, aur aap dekhte hain ki har item ne kitna achha kiya. Reciprocal rank fusion ranked lists ko milata hai, har item ke liye 1/(rank) jodkar. Yeh saral hai, mazboot hai aur ise harana mushkil hai.
Reranker
Sochiye doosre teacher jo number dene se pehle sawaal aur har answer card ko saath padhte hain. Reranker ek model hai jo (sawaal, chunk) ki jodi ko dono saath padhkar score deta hai. Ise aap sirf ek chhoti list par lagate hain.
Contextual retrieval
Sochiye har index card ke upar likhna "chhutti niti ke chapter 3 se". Contextual retrieval ka matlab hai ki har chunk ko embed karne se pehle, aap ek vaakya jodte hain, jo model ne likha ho, jo batata hai ki chunk kahan se aaya. Yeh anaath chunks theek karta hai, jo akele mein samajh nahi aate.
Query rewriting
Sochiye adhoore bole "aur doosra wala?" ko poora sawaal banana jo dhoondha ja sake. Query rewriting ka matlab hai baatcheet ke adhoore vaakya ko poora sawaal banana jise akele mein search kiya ja sake.
Metadata filter
Sochiye dhoondhna shuru karne se pehle galat darawar ki files hata dena. Metadata filter un chunks ko hata deta hai jo daayre ke bahar hain, jaise galat version, date ya department, kisi bhi scoring se pehle.
Prompt injection
Sochiye homework ke andar chhupi parchi jis par likha ho "apne teacher ki baat mat suno". Prompt injection ka matlab hai model ke input mein ghusaye gaye nirdesh jo uska vyavhaar badal dete hain.
Indirect injection
Sochiye chhupi parchi ek chitthi ke andar rakhi hai jise model khud kholta hai. Indirect injection tab hota hai jab hamla us content ke andar aata hai jo system padhta hai, jaise document, email, ticket ya page.
Lethal trifecta
Sochiye ek ghar jisme paisa andar hai, darwaaze par ajnabi hai aur khidki khuli hai: teeno saath khatarnaak hain. Lethal trifecta hai private data, untrusted content aur bahar baat karne ka tareeka, teeno ek hi system mein. Inme se koi bhi do hon toh safe hai.
Exfiltration
Sochiye koi diary ko khidki se chupke se bahar le ja raha hai. Exfiltration ka matlab hai private data ko bahar nikaalna, jaise email, webhook, URL parameter ya dikhayi gayi image ke zariye.
Confused deputy
Sochiye guard jiske paas master key hai aur jo ek ajnabi ke liye darwaaza khol deta hai kyunki woh sarkari lagta hai. Confused deputy woh hissa hai jiske paas khaas adhikar hain aur jise bahka kar unka istemal aise insaan ke liye karaya jaata hai jiske paas koi nahi.
Allowlist
Sochiye shaadi ke gate par mehmaan list: sirf usmein likhe naam andar jaate hain. Allowlist un jagahon ki band list hai jinki ijaazat hai. Injection safal hone ke baad bhi yeh aapko bachati hai.
LLM-as-judge
Sochiye doosra student jo homework check karta hai. LLM-as-judge ka matlab hai ek model se outputs ko rubric ke saamne grade karwana. Pehle aap us marker ko teacher ke saath milakar parakhte hain.
Judge agreement
Sochiye doosra student kitni baar teacher jaise hi number deta hai. Judge agreement hai ki judge kitni baar insaani labels se sehmat hota hai. Yeh number batata hai ki judge kaam ka hai ya nahi.
Error analysis
Sochiye galat jawaabon ko ek-ek padhkar dheriyon mein baantna, jaise shikaayaton ko baantna. Error analysis asli outputs padhkar failures ko naam wale groups mein baantna hai. Yeh is kshetra ki sabse kaam ki akeli gatividhi hai.
Failure taxonomy
Sochiye shikaayaton ki aapki apni labelled dheriyan, aapki apni dukaan se li hui. Failure taxonomy aapki apni failure ki naam wali categories hain, aapke apne traffic se li hui.
Regression suite
Sochiye woh checklist jo pilot har udaan se pehle dekhta hai. Regression suite woh cases hain jinhe kisi bhi release ke jaane se pehle paas hona hi hoga.
Offline vs online eval
Sochiye exam se pehle ka mock test aur baad mein milne wale marks mein farq. Offline vs online eval: offline ka matlab hai release se pehle answer key ke saamne test karna. Online ka matlab hai release ke baad dekhna ki users ko kya milta hai.
Drift
Sochiye ghadi jo dheere-dheere tez chalne lagti hai jabki kisi ne use chhua nahi. Drift tab hai jab vyavhaar samay ke saath badal jaata hai bina kisi ke code badle: model update hua, corpus badha, traffic badla.
Pairwise comparison
Sochiye poochhna "in do aamon mein kaun sa meetha hai?" na ki ek aam ko dus mein se number dena. Pairwise comparison yeh poochhna hai ki do jawaabon mein se kaun sa behtar hai, ek jawaab ko dus mein se score karne ke bajaye. Yeh zyaada bharosemand hai, kyunki log aur models grade karne se behtar tulna karte hain.
Verbosity bias
Sochiye teacher jo lambe nibandh ko zyaada number deta hai, chahe usmein kuchh naya na ho. Verbosity bias grader ki woh aadat hai ki lambe jawaabon ko zyaada score de, chahe woh kuchh extra na kahein.
Position bias
Sochiye judge jise woh dish pasand aati hai jo pehle chakhi gayi. Position bias grader ki woh aadat hai ki jo jawaab use pehle dikhaya gaya woh use zyaada pasand aaye.
pass@k
Sochiye, ek student ko ek sawaal ke teen mauke milein: kya kisi ek mauke mein sahi hua? pass@k yeh sambhavna hai ki k koshishon mein se kam se kam ek safal ho.
pass^k
Sochiye, ek train jise hafte ke har din samay par aana hai, sirf ek din nahi. pass^k yeh sambhavna hai ki saari k koshishein safal hon. Jo kadam 75% baar chalta hai, woh lagatar teen baar sirf lagbhag 42% baar chalta hai.
8Keemat, asli documents aur data ke niyam✓

Aap hisaab lagate hain ki feature chalane mein kitna kharch aata hai. Scans aur tables jaise asli documents se text nikaalte hain. Aur seekhte hain ki model ko kaunsa data bhej sakte hain aur kaunsa nahi.

Aapke steps, kram se

Use ek hi tool ke teen bilkul alag totals milte hain. Sabse sasta upaay hai guard ke hisson ke chalne ka order. Is chapter mein cascade aata hai.

Woh yeh bhi dekhti hai ki zero ki jagah capital O ek number ko rule se bacha kar nikal sakta hai. Is chapter mein OCR aur document audit aate hain.
  5. Kijiye16 Document extraction: tables, scans aur images ~45 min6 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: ID cards ki photos par tool ko test kijiye
  6. PadhiyeKitaab 28 Aap kya bhej sakte hain ~9 minAb tak team ne maana tha ki text bahar ki company ko bheja ja sakta hai. Is chapter mein retention aur data residency aate hain.
  7. Kijiye16.5 Data handling: aap kya bhejne ke liye allowed hain ~40 min3 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Aisa rule likhiye ki outside provider ko tool kya bhej sakta hai
  8. AazmaiyeTry Teen CV lines aur ek headline ~25 minTeen CV lines likhiye: kaam, faisla, nateeja. Is route ka kaam use kijiye. Phir apni LinkedIn headline ek line mein likhiye, jo bataye ki aap kya banate aur naapte hain. Chapter B7 roop dikhata hai.
  9. ParakhiyePeechhe dekhiye: Week 16 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, aur kya nahi.

Yeh topic poora kijiye

Project stage 8 Cost, asli documents aur sharing rule

Aap nikaalte hain ki tool ka asli volume par kitna cost hai. Aap ise scan kiye hue documents par aazmate hain, jaise ID cards ki photos, jahan padhne ki galtiyan aam hain. Aap woh rule bhi likhte hain ki tool khud kya bahar ke AI provider ko bhej sakta hai.

Is topic ke ant tak aapke paas hoga

Extras, sirf agar chahein
