Aur gehraai mein (9)

  • Case The New Business of AI (and How It’s Different From Traditional Software) Casado and Bornstein, a16z, 2020AI products ke gross margins classic software se kam kyun hote hain, aur iska pricing par kya asar padta hai.
  • Case Mistral OCR Mistral AI, 2025Ek vendor ka document padhne wala model, apni benchmark table ke saath. Ise ek daave ki tarah padhiye jise apne scans par parkhna hai.
  • Case Samsung bans staff’s AI use after spotting ChatGPT data leak The Register, 2023Engineers ne source code aur meeting notes ek public chatbot mein paste kar diye. Is chapter ka data wala sawaal, bahut der se poocha gaya.
  • Paper FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance Chen, Zaharia and Zou, 2023Pehle saste phir mehnge models ki cascade ne sabse achhe model jitni quality bahut kam kharche mein di.
  • Paper RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs with Preference Data Ong et al., 2024Ek chhota router tay karta hai ki kin sawaalon ko mehnga model chahiye. Unke tests mein kharcha aadha.
  • Paper LayoutLM: Pre-training of Text and Layout for Document Image Understanding Xu et al., Microsoft, 2019Form padhne ke liye words kahan hain yeh bhi chahiye, sirf kaun se words nahi. Woh model jisne yeh dikhaya.
  • Paper OCR-free Document Understanding Transformer (Donut) Kim et al., 2021Document ki image seedhe structured fields mein padhna, alag OCR step ke bina.
  • Paper Nougat: Neural Optical Understanding for Academic Documents Blecher et al., Meta, 2023Scanned PDFs ko, tables aur formulas samet, text mein badalna. Dhyaan dijiye ki yeh ab bhi kahan fail hota hai.
  • Paper Extracting Training Data from Large Language Models Carlini et al., 2020Model woh rare text dohra sakta hai jis par woh train hua, naam aur phone numbers samet. Training data privacy ka sawaal kyun hai.

Is topic ke shabd (19)

Cost per query
Sochiye har SMS ka paisa dena, un ka bhi jo aap dobara bhejte hain. Cost per query ek request ki poori laagat hai jo user dekh sakta hai, retries aur agent steps ke saath.
Cascade
Sochiye pehle junior clerk se poochhna, aur file senior ke paas tabhi bhejna jab junior ko pakka na ho. Cascade pehle sasta model aazmana hai aur check fail hone par bade model par jaana. Production mein laagat sambhalne ka yeh mukhya tareeka hai.
Model routing
Sochiye dak ghar jo har chitthi ko sahi gaadi mein daalta hai. Model routing ka matlab hai har request ke liye ek model chunna, is hisaab se ki woh request kitni mushkil hai.
Unit economics
Sochiye chai ki tapri ka har ek cup par munafa. Unit economics use ki har ikai ki laagat aur kamayi hai. Yahi number tay karta hai ki feature bachega ya nahi.
Vision-language model
Sochiye ek tota jo tasveerein aur shabd dono padh sakta hai. Vision-language model images aur text ko saath padhta hai.
Page-as-chunk
Sochiye poore page ki photo ko ek index card ki tarah rakhna. Page-as-chunk ka matlab hai poore dikhaye hue page ko retrieve hone wali ikai banana, text ke tukde ke bajaye.
Modality gap
Sochiye photocopy jisme chitra chhoot jaate hain aur sirf shabd dikhte hain. Modality gap woh jaankari hai jo page par hai lekin usse nikaale gaye text mein nahi hai.
Turn detection
Sochiye yeh pehchaanna ki saamne wala bol chuka hai taaki aap jawaab de sakein. Turn detection ka matlab hai tay karna ki bolne wala kab bol chuka. Voice interfaces ki yahi sabse badi samasya hai.
Blended rate
Sochiye har cup ki average keemat jab kuchh cup mehengi chai ke hon aur kuchh sasti ke. Blended rate woh hai jo aap har query par average mein dete hain jab traffic alag keemat wale kai models mein bant jaata hai.
Cache hit rate
Sochiye dukaandaar jo kam paisa leta hai kyunki use aapka roz ka order yaad hai. Cache hit rate aapke input ka woh hissa hai jise provider ne pichhli request se pehchaana aur kam daam liya.
Vision model
Sochiye tota jo tasveer dekh bhi sakta hai aur padh bhi sakta hai. Vision model tasveerein aur text dono padhta hai, isliye aap use nikaale hue text ke bajaye page ki image de sakte hain.
OCR
Sochiye typist jo page ki photo se shabd utaarta hai lekin page kaisa dikhta hai us par dhyaan nahi deta. OCR software hai jo page ki tasveer ko text mein badalta hai. Yeh shabd rakhta hai aur layout phenk deta hai.
Layout
Sochiye form par rows, columns aur boxes kahan hain. Layout woh hai ki cheezein page par kahan baithi hain: rows, columns, boxes. Ismein woh matlab hota hai jo saada text kho deta hai.
Barge-in
Sochiye koi aap ke bolte-bolte beech mein bol pade. Barge-in tab hota hai jab koi insaan system ke beech vaakya mein uske upar bol deta hai. Voice interfaces ko ise sambhalna padta hai; text wale ko yeh kabhi nahi jhelna padta.
DPDP Act
Sochiye kisi ki diary: kanoon batata hai ki aap use kaise istemal kar sakte hain aur kab wapas dena ya nasht karna hai. DPDP Act India ka Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 hai, jiske Rules 2025 se hain. Yeh batata hai ki koi sansthan personal data jama karne, istemal karne ya share karne se pehle kya kare, jaise sahmati maangna.
Cost per successful answer
Sochiye, delivery ka asli kharcha jab kuch parcel wapas aakar dobara bhejne padte hain. Cost per successful answer ek call ka kharcha, guna ek achhe jawaab ke liye lagne wali calls hai, taaki retries bhi gine jaayein.
FOCUS billing format
Sochiye, ek hi bill ka dhaancha jise har phone company maan le. FOCUS FinOps Foundation ka khula format hai cloud aur software ke bills ke liye, taaki alag providers ke kharche jode ja sakein aur team ya feature ke hisaab se baante ja sakein.
DPDP Rules 2025
Sochiye, naye kaanoon ke baad aane wali vistaar wali niyam-pustika: kaanoon jo kehta hai use kaise karein. DPDP Rules 2025 batate hain ki India ka DPDP Act kaise follow karein: notice, consent, data ki suraksha, breach hone par logon ko batana, aur bachchon ka data. Zyadatar duties 13 May 2027 se shuru hoti hain.
Significant Data Fiduciary (SDF)
Sochiye, ek bada aspatal jahan health inspector har saal aata hai, jabki chhota clinic kam jaancha jaata hai. SDF woh sanstha hai jise sarkar bahut saara sensitive personal data sambhalne wali maanti hai, isliye uski extra duties hain: har saal impact assessment aur audit, aur yeh jaanchna ki uske algorithms logon ke adhikaron ko nuksaan na pahunchayein.
9Governance, spec, aur product ke faisle✓

Aap woh niyam likhte hain jo system ko maanne hain. Aur ek spec likhte hain, jisse koi aur bana sake. Phir product ke faisle lete hain: banayein ya khareedein, fine-tune karein ya nahi, model galat ho to kya ho, aur pilot kaise saabit kare ki yeh kaam karta hai.

Aapke steps, kram se

  1. Week 17 · Niyam, aur spec 8 Feb – 14 Feb
  2. PadhiyeKitaab 29 Rules, risk aur zimmedaari ~11 minLakshmi batati hai ki bank mein bees saal kaam karke usne paperwork ke baare mein kya seekha. Phir team ek page ka document likhti hai. Usme likha hai ki guard kis kaam ka hai, kya galat karta hai aur use kis kaam mein kabhi nahi lena. Uske baad woh ek customer ko delete karne ki koshish karte hain aur dekhte hain ki uska data kahan-kahan rehta hai. Chapter mein risk tiers, India ka data protection law, system cards, deletion drills, human oversight aur shadow AI aate hain.
  3. Kijiye17 AI governance: risk tiers, system cards aur oversight ~45 min5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Bharat Privacy Guard ka system card likhiye
  4. PadhiyeKitaab 30 The spec for a thing that varies ~9 minEk notice kehta hai ki ek model tees din mein retire hoga. Isse dikhta hai ki spec (product ka recipe card) mein kya hona chahiye jab software do baar ek jaisa kaam nahi karta. Yeh bhi dikhta hai ki AI band karne wale switch ko kya chalta chhodna chahiye. Chapter mein rollback, kill switch aur pinned versions aate hain.
  5. Kijiye18 AI PRD: specs, migrations aur kill switches ~60 min5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Aisa requirements document likhiye jo model badalne par bhi kaam kare
  6. ParakhiyePeechhe dekhiye: Week 17 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, aur kya nahi.
  7. Week 18 · Banaye ya khareedein, aur galat jawaab ke liye design 15 Feb – 21 Feb
  8. PadhiyeKitaab 31 Build, buy or teach it ~10 minEk vendor team ko woh bechna chahta hai jo team ne chhe mahine mein banaya. Ek founder kehta hai ki apna model train kijiye. Dono idea samajhdaar lagte hain, aur dono ko ek hi test pass karna hai. Chapter mein AI value chain, open-weight models, fine-tuning aur lock-in aate hain.
  9. Kijiye18.5 Build or buy: vendor ki apne build se comparison ~40 min2 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Sifarish kijiye ki kya khud banayein aur kya kharidein
  10. Kijiye19 Fine-tuning karein ya nahi: kya badalna hai, yeh kaise chunein ~45 min3 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Model ko fine-tune karne ke prastaav ka jawaab saboot se dijiye
  11. PadhiyeKitaab 32 Galat jawaab ke liye design ~10 minJo tool das mein se nau baar sahi hai, woh dasvi baar galat hota hai. Tab screen kya karti hai, usi se tay hota hai ki log bharosa karenge ya nahi. Phir ek pilot, jo fail hone ke liye bhi bana tha, ajeeb result deta hai. Tool kaam karta hai, aur kuch badalta nahi. Aap refusals, pilots aur failure thresholds se milte hain.
  12. Kijiye20 Galat jawaab ke liye design: evidence, confidence aur refusals ~45 min3 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Un chaar jawaabon ko design kijiye jo tool de sakta hai
  13. Kijiye20.5 Business impact naapna: ek pilot design karna ~40 min2 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Aisa pilot design kijiye jo fail ho sake
  14. AazmaiyeTry Do aur baatcheet ~30 minDo aur logon se baat kijiye jinhe yeh problem hai. Ek ko Week 3 se alag role mein chuniye. Wahi do sawaal poochhiye aur har ek ke paanch lines likhiye. Week 3 ke saath yeh teen ho jaate hain. Capstone shuru karne ke liye itna kaafi hai.
  15. ParakhiyePeechhe dekhiye: Week 18 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, aur kya nahi.

Yeh topic poora kijiye

Project stage 9 Plan aur kaagzi kaam likhiye

Aap woh documents likhte hain jo ek asli team maangegi. Yeh hain: ek system card, ek requirements document aur ek build-or-buy recommendation. Aap yeh bhi likhte hain ki model fine-tune karna chahiye ya nahi (use bahut saare examples se coach karna). Tool ke jawaab dene ke 4 tareekon ki screens design karte hain, aur ek pilot plan likhte hain.

Is topic ke ant tak aapke paas hoga

Extras, sirf agar chahein

Kis par tika hai

  • Aapne ise naapa hai, isliye number ke saath bol sakte hain 14 se, Topic 7 Answer key (sawaal aur sahi jawaab) aur failures ki list daave ko number bana deti hai.
  • Version aur access filters (woh rules jo woh chhupate hain jo insaan ko nahi dekhna chahiye) ranking se pehle lagte hain 12 se, Topic 7 Isiliye yehi akele vaade hain jo aap kar sakte hain.
  • Injection (chhupi parchi jo model se kehti hai ki apne rules bhool jao) ke khilaaf poori suraksha nahi hai 13 se, Topic 7 Isliye safety controls model ke bahar rehte hain, prompt (model ko di jaane wali parchi) mein nahi.
  • Ek test set (sahi jawaab pehle se pata wale sawaal) aur aapke apne failures ki list 14 se, Topic 7 Yeh “accha kaam karna chahiye” jaise niyam ko ek number bana dete hain.
  • Ek asli kharch ka number 15 se, Topic 8 Poora number, un chaaron cheezon ke saath jo use badhati hain.
  • Aap retrieval khud naap sakte hain: system sahi page kitna accha dhoondhta hai 6 se, Topic 5 Taaki aap demo par bharosa karne ki jagah vendor ko test kar sakein.
  • Failure taxonomy (aapke apne failures ki list), ginti ke saath 14 se, Topic 7 Fix tabhi chun sakte hain jab pata ho kya galat ho raha hai aur kitni baar, jaise doctor dawa dene se pehle bimari dhoondhta hai.
  • Ek test set (sahi jawaab pehle se pata wale sawaal) jis par aap bharosa karein 6 se, Topic 5 Iske bina aap dekh nahi sakte ki is chapter ka koi bhi badlaav asal mein kya kar gaya.
  • Zaroori quote se jaanchna sasta ho jata hai 8 se, Topic 6 Quote confidence number se zyada kaam ka hai. Yeh kitab ke page number jaisa hai: aap jaakar dekh sakte hain.
  • User ko dheemi responses dikhti hain 11 se, Topic 6 Unhe sabse dheemi wali dikhti hain, average response time nahi. Jaise woh ek late train, na ki das time par aayi trains.
  • Aap system ko naap sakte hain 14 se, Topic 7 Matlab recall, precision, judges aur har category ke scores. Recall yeh hai ki talaab ki kitni machhliyan aapke jaal mein aayin. Precision yeh hai ki jaal mein jo hai, uska kitna hissa sach mein machhli hai.

Aur gehraai mein (18)

  • Case AI Risk Management Framework NIST, 2023Woh framework jis par kai companies aur sarkarein apni AI governance map karti hain: govern, map, measure, manage.
  • Case EU Artificial Intelligence Act: explorer Future of Life InstituteKaanoon mein risk tiers: Act ko article se search kijiye aur dekhiye ki koi feature kis tier mein aayega.
  • Case Rules of Machine Learning Martin Zinkevich, GoogleGoogle ki production ML se taintaalis niyam, shuruaat “bina machine learning ke product launch karne se mat dariye” se.
  • Case What We Learned from a Year of Building with LLMs Yan, Bischof, Frye, Husain, Liu, Shankar, O’Reilly, 2024Chhah practitioners batate hain ki production mein asal mein kya chala: prompts, retrieval, evals, aur kab model use nahi karna.
  • Case Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149 BC Civil Resolution Tribunal, 2024Ek airline ke chatbot ne refund ka niyam khud bana diya aur airline ko use maanna pada. Chatbot jo kehta hai uski zimmedaari company ki hai.
  • Case Klarna’s AI assistant handles two-thirds of customer service chats OpenAI customer story, 2024Sabse mashhoor support deployment: ek mahine mein 23 lakh chats. Ise un baad ki khabron ke saath padhiye ki Klarna ne log wapas rakhe.
  • Paper Model Cards for Model Reporting Mitchell et al., 2019Us ek page ke document ka asli prastaav jo batata hai ki model kis liye hai, kaise test hua aur kahan fail hota hai.
  • Paper Datasheets for Datasets Gebru et al., 2018Kisi bhi dataset ke baare mein jawaab dene wale sawaal: kyun bana, usme kya hai, kis kaam mein use nahi karna.
  • Paper Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems Sculley et al., Google, NeurIPS 2015Model beech ka chhota sa dabba hai; kharcha uske aas-paas ki har cheez ka hai. LLMs ke saath bhi sach.
  • Paper BloombergGPT: A Large Language Model for Finance Wu et al., Bloomberg, 2023Ek firm ne bahut kharche se apna finance model banaya; general models ne jaldi hi barabari kar li. Ise build-or-buy case ki tarah padhiye.
  • Paper Fine-Tuning or Retrieval? Comparing Knowledge Injection in LLMs Ovadia et al., Microsoft, 2023Facts jodne ke liye retrieval ne fine-tuning ko lagataar haraaya. Fine-tune vyavhaar aur format ke liye kijiye, gyaan ke liye nahi.
  • Paper Does Fine-Tuning LLMs on New Knowledge Encourage Hallucinations? Gekhman et al., Google, 2024Fine-tuning se model ko naye facts sikhane se uske baatein banane ki sambhavna badh gayi.
  • Paper LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models Hu et al., Microsoft, 2021Fine-tuning sasti kyun hui: poore model ki jagah ek chhota add-on train kijiye.
  • Paper Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction Amershi et al., Microsoft, CHI 2019Atharah parkhe hue guidelines, is hisaab se ki kab lagte hain, “jab galat ho” samet. Kisi bhi AI screen ke liye checklist.
  • Paper Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know Kadavath et al., Anthropic, 2022Models apne sahi hone ki sambhavna ka andaaza laga sakte hain, aur confidence dikhane ke liye yahi chahiye.
  • Paper Generative AI at Work Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond, NBER, 20235,000 support agents ke saath ek AI assistant: har ghante 14% zyada issues hal, aur zyadatar fayda naye agents ko.
  • Paper Navigating the Jagged Technological Frontier Dell’Acqua et al., Harvard Business School and BCG, 2023758 consultants: AI ne kuch tasks par unhe tez aur behtar banaya aur kuch par kharab. Aisa pilot banaiye jo farq bata sake.
  • Paper Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity Becker et al., METR, 2025Anubhavi developers ko laga AI unhe 20% tez karega; naapne par woh 19% dheeme hue. Poochne ki jagah naapna kyun zaroori hai.

Is topic ke shabd (26)

Risk tier
Sochiye jhoole ki jaanch: bachchon ka jhoola bench se zyaada kadai se jaancha jaata hai. Risk tier hai ki aapke kartavya kitne kade hain. Yeh is par tikta hai ki system galat hua toh kya hoga, technology par nahi.
System card
Sochiye dawai ke dabbe par label: yeh kis liye hai, kaise jaancha gaya, kahan fail ho sakta hai, aur kaun jaanchta hai. System card ek chhota document hai jo batata hai ki AI feature kis liye hai, usmein kya naapa gaya, woh kahan fail hota hai, aur kaun use check karta hai.
Data lineage
Sochiye parcel ki kahaani: kisne bheja, kya aap use khol sakte hain, kahan rakha hai aur kitni der ke liye. Data lineage hai ki data kahan se aaya, use istemal karne ka aapko kya haq hai, woh kahan rakha hai, aur kitni der ke liye.
Human oversight
Sochiye clerk ka kaam jise afsar manzoor karta hai ya palat deta hai. Human oversight ek tay jagah hai jahan koi insaan output dekh sakta hai, aur use palatne ka adhikar rakhta hai.
Shadow AI
Sochiye karmchaari apne bina manzoor kiye gadgets office mein laa rahe hain. Shadow AI hai staff ka aise AI tools istemal karna jinhe kisi ne manzoor nahi kiya. Yeh sach mein hota hai aur naapa ja sakta hai. Yeh koi kalpanik chinta nahi hai.
AI PRD
Sochiye recipe card jiska pass mark ek naam wale test sawaalon ke set par ek score hai. AI PRD ek product specification hai jahan acceptance criteria eval thresholds hote hain, jo ek naam wale dataset par naape jaate hain.
Model pinning
Sochiye har baar wahi brand aur batch ka aata mangwana, taaki rotiyan ek jaisi banein. Model pinning ek pakka model version tay karna hai, taaki aapke neeche se vyavhaar na badal jaye.
Deprecation migration
Sochiye aapka pakka supplier band ho gaya, toh naye ko phir se parakhna padta hai. Deprecation migration woh dobara evaluation hai jo aapko karna padta hai jab provider aapka istemal kiya hua model hata deta hai.
Kill switch
Sochiye bijli ke board ka main switch: ek jhatke mein bijli band. Kill switch ek flag hai jise aap turant palat kar traffic us raaste par bhej sakte hain jo AI istemal nahi karta. Yeh rollback nahi hai.
Fine-tuning
Sochiye model ko bahut saare examples se coaching dena taaki use ek aadat pad jaye. Fine-tuning model ki training ko aapke apne examples par aage badhana hai taaki woh ek vyavhaar apna le. Yeh dhang aur lehja sikhata hai, tikaau tathya nahi. Chapter 19 mein iska faisla hai.
Audit trail
Sochiye dukaan ka bahi-khata jisse baad mein koi dekh sake ki kya hua aur kyun. Audit trail system ne kya kiya aur kyun, uska record hai, taaki koi baad mein jaanch sake.
Data residency
Sochiye aapka keemti saaman kis desh ki tijori mein rakha hai. Data residency yeh hai ki aapka data kis desh mein asal mein store aur process hota hai.
Subprocessor
Sochiye dukaan aapka parcel ek aise courier ko de deti hai jisse aap kabhi nahi mile. Subprocessor ek aur company hai jise aapka provider aapka data deta hai. Unka risk aapka ban jaata hai.
Eval threshold
Sochiye woh pass mark jo copy ko result nikalne se pehle chhoona hota hai. Eval threshold woh number hai jise release ko jaane se pehle chhoona hota hai. Yeh ek acceptance criterion hai jisme ek aankda hai.
Staged rollout
Sochiye nayi dukaan pehle ek gali mein kholna, aur sab theek raha tabhi badhana. Staged rollout ka matlab hai pehle users ke ek chhote hisse ko release dena aur numbers dekhna, phir aage badhna.
Distillation
Sochiye student jo ek vishay ke topper ke sabse achhe notes utaarta hai. Distillation ek chhote model ko bade model ki nakal karna sikhana hai ek sankre kaam par. Aapko zyaadatar quality kuchh hi laagat par mil jaati hai.
Portability
Sochiye saaman jo aap ek train se doosri train mein le ja sakte hain. Portability yeh hai ki kya sudhaar provider badalne par bhi bacha rehta hai. Behtar prompt aur index aapke saath jaate hain; tune kiya hua model nahi jaata.
Diagnosis
Sochiye doctor jo dawai dene se pehle bimaari ka naam batata hai, jaanchon ki ginti ke saath. Diagnosis yeh naam dena hai ki aapke saath kis tarah ki galti hai, ginti ke saath, kuchh badalne se pehle.
Interface contract
Sochiye traffic light: hara, peela aur laal, har ek driver ko batata hai ki kya karna hai. Interface contract woh hai jo product vaada karta hai ki woh yakeen ke har star par dikhayega, aur user ko uske baare mein kya karne dega.
Resolvable citation
Sochiye footnote jo ekdum sahi line par khulta hai, sirf kitaab ka naam nahi. Resolvable citation ek source link hai jo wahi ansh kholta hai jahan se daava aaya, sirf document ka naam nahi.
Correction path
Sochiye dukaan mein "galti batayein" ka counter. Correction path yeh hai ki user galat output kaise theek karta hai, aur woh sudhaar aapke liye kya record karta hai.
Graceful degradation
Sochiye lift jo bijli jaane par bhi seedhi ki tarah kaam aati hai. Graceful degradation yeh hai ki AI wala hissa band hone par bhi feature kya kar sakta hai.
Governance
Sochiye ghar ke niyam, notice board aur woh naam wale bade jo kuchh bigadne par jawaab dete hain. Governance woh niyam, documents aur naam wale log hain jo tay karte hain ki AI system ka istemal kaise ho sakta hai, use kaun jaanchta hai, aur bigadne par kaun jawabdeh hai.
AI management system standard (ISO 42001)
Sochiye, rasoi ka hygiene certificate: woh rasoi ki aadatein jaanchta hai, ek dish nahi. ISO/IEC 42001 woh antarrashtriya standard hai jo batata hai ki ek sanstha apna AI kaam zimmedari se kaise chalaye, aur sanstha iske against certify ho sakti hai.
AI impact assessment standard (ISO 42005)
Sochiye, nayi sadak banane se pehle yeh jaanchna ki kisko nuksaan ho sakta hai. ISO/IEC 42005 margdarshan deta hai ki ek AI system logon aur samaaj par kya asar daal sakta hai, ise ship karne se pehle aur baad mein kaise aanka jaaye.
India AI Governance Guidelines
Sochiye, school ki achhe vyavhaar ki salaah, desh ka kaanoon nahi. India ki AI Governance Guidelines (MeitY, November 2025) surakshit aur bharosemand AI ke liye saat siddhant rakhti hain. Yeh kaanoon nahi hain; zaroori duties ab bhi DPDP Act jaise kaanoonon aur sector regulators se aati hain.
10Production ki gehraai: ise sahi tareeke se banana✓

Wahi ideas dobara, utni gehraai tak jitni production team jaati hai: software basics, model chunna, context, retrieval, workflows, agents, standard connections, tasveerein aur awaaz, aur release gates.

Aapke steps, kram se

  1. Week 19 · Production ki gehraai shuru: plumbing, aur model chunna 22 Feb – 28 Feb
  2. PadhiyeKitaab 33 Jaadu ke neeche ki plumbing ~9 minDo ghante tak guard se galti hui, aur kahin koi error nahi dikha. Isliye Anaya us ek unpredictable hisse ke aas-paas ka aam software padhna seekhti hai, jaise plumber ka pipes ka naqsha. Aap data contracts, Python, HTTP aur status codes, environment variables, Git aur experiment runners se milte hain.
  3. Kijiye21 AI kaam ke liye software basics: Python, HTTP, Git aur tests ~75 minProject ka kaam: Test harness banaiye aur use Git mein rakhiye
  4. PadhiyeKitaab 34 Apne cases par model chunna ~9 minEk founder us model par switch karna chahta hai jo pichhle hafte ke chart mein sabse upar tha. Team wahi karti hai jo aap car kharidne se pehle karte hain. Woh teen models ko apni sadkon par test drive karte hain, faisla ek card par likhte hain, aur tay karte hain ki har model kya dekhega. Aap leaderboards, routing, model selection cards aur provenance se milte hain.

Project stage 10 Ise theek se banaiye

Is topic ke shabd (2)

Release gate
Sochiye railway gate ka ticket checker: sahi ticket ke bina koi andar nahi jaata. Release gate woh check hai jo users tak badlaav pahunchne se pehle paas hona chahiye. AI products mein ismein tests ke saath eval thresholds bhi aate hain.
Eval saturation
Sochiye, ek test jismein poori class ko poore number milte hain: ab woh nahi batata ki kaun behtar hai. Eval saturation tab hota hai jab system eval ke lagbhag saare cases pass kar leta hai, aur eval naya kuch nahi batata. Aise cases regression suite mein daaliye aur mushkil naye cases likhiye.
11Production ki gehraai: ise surakshit chalana✓

Ise asal mein chalana. Aap traces, cost aur rollback seekhte hain. Aise model ke aas-paas security controls lagate hain jis par poora bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta. Kabhi-kabhi galat hone wale system ka spec likhte hain. Aur seekhte hain ki use deliver kaise karte hain.

Model ko behkaya ja sakta hai, isliye uske aas-paas ka system hi bachaav hai. Aap milte hain attack surface, least privilege, red team, audit trail, risk register aur residual risk se.
  6. Kijiye31 Security aur governance: ek untrusted model ke aas-paas controls ~70 minProject ka kaam: Risk register likhiye, har control ke saath ek test ke saath
  7. PadhiyeKitaab 40 Ek product, demo nahi ~11 minDo logon ke liye achha bana khana abhi restaurant ke menu mein nahi hota. Festival season se pehle team woh sab likhti hai jo ek chalte prototype aur asli service ke beech khada hai. Har bade decision ke liye woh yeh bhi likhti hai ki kya hone par woh use palat denge. Aap milte hain production delta, graceful degradation, staging, latency budget, architecture decision record aur exit cost se.

Is topic ke shabd (3)

Throughput
Sochiye ek tapri ghante bhar mein kitne cup chai deti hai. Throughput woh hai ki ek system diye hue samay mein kitna kaam nipta leta hai, jaise requests per minute. Latency ek request ka intezaar hai; throughput yeh hai ki kitne ho gaye.
CERT-In 6-hour rule
Sochiye, ek fire alarm jo chhe ghante ke andar fire station tak bajna chahiye. CERT-In ke 2022 ke directions ke tahat India mein kai sansthaon ko kuch cyber incidents 6 ghante ke andar report karne hote hain, system logs India mein 180 din rakhne hote hain, aur apni ghadiyan sync karni hoti hain.
OWASP Agentic Top 10
Sochiye, errand par gaye helper ko bevakoof banane ya galat hone ke das sabse aam tareekon ki list. OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (December 2025) AI agents ke mukhya security khatre batati hai, jaise goal hijack aur tool misuse, ASI01 se ASI10 tak.

  • Case Hallucination-Free? Assessing the Reliability of Leading AI Legal Research Tools Magesh et al., Stanford, 2024RAG par bane commercial legal tools ne bhi 17–33% baar baatein banayin. Vendor ke “no hallucinations” daave ki asli jaanch.
  • Paper Seven Failure Points When Engineering a Retrieval Augmented Generation System Barnett et al., 2024Teen asli RAG systems, saat jagah jahan woh toote. Review ke liye taiyaar checklist.
13Business, aur aapka career✓

Product ke aas-paas ka business: pricing, growth, analytics, tools aur asli users. Phir naukri khud: aapka portfolio, aapki kahani aur practice interviews.

Aapke steps, kram se

  1. Week 26 · Business 12 Apr – 18 Apr
  2. PadhiyeKitaab 42 Kaun paisa deta hai, aur kitna ~12 minEk lender ka technical lead poochta hai ki guard use kitne ka padega. Jawaab teen alag logon aur charge karne ke chaar tareekon par tikta hai. Ek aisi row par bhi, jo zyadatar price lists mein hoti hi nahi. Aap seat, usage, outcome aur hybrid pricing, contribution margin, flywheel aur gross margin se milte hain.
  3. KijiyeB1 Business models, pricing aur unit economics ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 12 ghante5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Daam tay kijiye, aur dikhaiye ki aapke numbers sahi hain
  4. PadhiyeKitaab 43 Log product kaise dhoondhte hain aur kyun tikte hain ~10 minJis tool ko koi dhoondh hi na paaye, woh kisi ko bachata nahi. Paanch developers ko sirf ek README milta hai, aur ek stopwatch dikhata hai ki woh kahan chhod dete hain. Ek spelling checker dikhata hai ki value ka pehla pal kahan aana chahiye. Aap AARRR, activation, time-to-value, Fogg behaviour model, product-led growth, growth loop, network effect, virality aur dark pattern se milte hain.
  5. KijiyeB2 Growth, onboarding aur product marketing ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 12 ghante5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Plan kijiye ki tool kaise badhega, aur pehle paanch minute ko test kijiye
  6. PadhiyeKitaab 44 Jo maayne rakhta hai use ginna ~9 minAb asli log tool use karte hain. Isliye sawaal "kya yeh kaam karta hai?" se badal kar "woh kya karte hain?" ho jaata hai. Privacy tool ko ginna hai, par woh cheez rakhni nahi jo woh chhupata hai. Phir ek chhota hisaab dikhata hai ki ek nayi company woh test kyun nahi chala sakti jo woh chahti hai. Chapter mein event taxonomy, tracking plan, cohort, A/B test aur minimum detectable effect aate hain.
  7. KijiyeB3 Product analytics aur experiments ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 14 ghante5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Measurements plan kijiye, aur ek experiment design kijiye
  8. PadhiyeKitaab 45 Tools aur harness ~15 minEk naya engineer poochta hai ki kaun sa tool kis kaam ka hai. Ek senior engineer brands ki list nahi, khaali slots ki drawing se jawaab deta hai. Phir naya engineer ek weekly report do baar banata hai, ek baar fixed steps se aur ek baar agent se. Dono ko wahi bees hafton par naapa jaata hai. Chapter mein toolchain, claim audit, harness, project memory, allowlist, verifier, sub-agent, state machine, feature flag, rollback trigger aur incident review aate hain.
  9. KijiyeB4 AI product workflow ke liye tools chunna ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 2.5 ghante1 hands-on exercise · Project ka kaam: Har kaam ke liye ek tool chuniye, aur dekhiye ki har tool aapke data ke saath kya karta hai
  10. KijiyeB5 Harness engineering: model ke aaspaas ka system ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 12 ghante4 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Model ke aaspaas ka harness banaiye, aur safe release ki taiyari kijiye
  11. PadhiyeKitaab 46 Asli log, asli use ~11 minDemo tab tak chalta hai jab tak aap dekh rahe hote hain. Asli product ko tab chalna hota hai jab koi nahi dekh raha, un logon ke liye jinka aap par koi haq nahi. Spring mein Anaya guard ko ajnabiyon ke liye taiyaar karti hai. Woh imaandaar early users dhoondhti hai aur bina madad kiye unhe dekhti hai. Phir jo dekha, uski wajah se ek change ship karti hai. Aap design partner, informed consent, observation session, changelog aur support log seekhte hain.
  12. KijiyeB6 Asli users tak pahunchiye aur learning loop chalaiye ~20 min · poora karne mein lagbhag 18 ghante5 hands-on exercises · Project ka kaam: Ise asli users ke saamne rakhiye, aur jo dekhein usse ek sudhaar kijiye
  13. AazmaiyeTry Project wahan rakhiye jahan log use dekh sakein ~60 minApna findings page aur capstone write-up ek page par, ek link ke saath publish kijiye. Ise saada rakhiye. Jo page maujood hai, woh sundar page se behtar hai. Agar repository abhi private hai, to uski history mein keys aur asli personal details dekhiye. Phir use public kijiye, aur woh ek command link kijiye jo aapki answer key chalati hai.
  14. ParakhiyePeechhe dekhiye: Week 26 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, aur kya nahi.
  15. Week 27 · Naukri 19 Apr – 25 Apr
  16. PadhiyeKitaab 47 Kaam aur naukri ~15 minRhea pehle sarkari technology programmes chalati thi. Usne kuch asli banaya hai aur use dikhana nahi aata. Kuch Sunday shaamon mein Anaya uski madad karti hai. Ek saal ka kaam teen cheezon mein badalta hai: jin jobs ki use chaah hai unka naksha, saboot ka ek page, aur woh jawaab jo job tay karte hain. Aap role matrix, case study, product sense, system-design interview, STAR method aur take-home seekhte hain.

  18. AazmaiyeTry Das postings se ek role matrix ~45 minChapter B7 jis role matrix ko batata hai, use banaiye. Das asli postings lijiye aur unki maangi hui skills ki list banaiye. Har skill ko proven, partly proven ya missing mark kijiye. Apne pehle darwaze ke liye sabse zaroori teen gaps chuniye. Har ek par aap kya karenge, likhiye.
  19. AazmaiyeTry Bharat Privacy Guard ki case study ~75 minCase study us roop mein likhiye jo Chapter B7 dikhata hai. Ek ya do page rakhiye. Problem, aapke faisle, findings page ke numbers, ek imaandaar failure, aur aage aap kya karenge, likhiye. Sirf apni runs ke asli numbers use kijiye. Ise apni repository mein docs/case-study.md naam se save kijiye.
  20. AazmaiyeTry Portfolio page poora kijiye ~2 ghantePlan par di gayi portfolio site recipe kijiye. Isme lagbhag do ghante lagte hain. Week 26 mein shuru kiya page pehla draft hai. Case study ka link jodiye. Role matrix ki woh teen lines jodiye jo batati hain ki aap aaj kya dikha sakte hain.
  21. ParakhiyePeechhe dekhiye: Week 27 ~5 minPaanch minute: kya yaad raha, aur kya nahi.
  22. Week 28 · Interviews 26 Apr – 2 May 2027

Do sawaalon ke jawaab zor se dijiye aur record kijiye. Model se har jawaab rubric ke hisaab se score karwaiye, aur apna sabse kharab jawaab dohraiye. Phir ek free prototyping tool mein Bharat Privacy Guard ke liye paste-and-clean screen banaiye. Apne ko 45 minute dijiye, banate hue zor se bolte rahiye, aur record kijiye.

Yeh topic poora kijiye

Project stage 13 Business, aur aapka career

Aap decide karte hain ki uske paise kaise lene hain, woh kaise failega aur use kaise measure karna hai. Aap decide karte hain ki kaun se tools use karne hain, use safely kaise release karna hai aur asli users ke saamne kaise rakhna hai. Aakhir mein aap project ko apni agli job ke liye evidence bana dete hain.

Is topic ke ant tak aapke paas hoga

Extras, sirf agar chahein

Kis par tika hai

  • Market ka size (kitne buyers hain) aur alternatives ke naam A4 se, Topic 1 Aap daam isse tay karte hain ki customer uski jagah kya karta.
  • Cost per query 15 se, Topic 8 Idea 3 isi se cost stack (har kharche ki ek ke upar ek list) banata hai.
  • Build ya buy 18.5 se, Topic 9 Vendor par nirbhar rehna us faisle ka doosra pehlu hai.
  • Interview skills A3 se, Topic 1 Aap paanch logon ko onboarding se guzarte dekhenge.
  • Positioning statement (ek line: yeh kiske liye hai aur alag kyun hai) A4 se, Topic 1 Idea 5 isi par banta hai.
  • Prototype (kaam karne wala kaccha pehla version) A7 se, Topic 1 Onboarding test mein ek lagta hai.
  • Ek North Star metric (woh ek number jo asli fayda dikhata hai) A5 se, Topic 1 Idea 1 use aisi cheez bana deta hai jise aap naap sakein.
  • OKRs aur guardrail metrics (lakshya, aur woh numbers jo bigadne nahi chahiye) A6 se, Topic 1 Experiments mein wahi guardrails kaam aate hain.
  • Evaluation engineering (model ko answer key se test karna) 29 se, Topic 10 Idea 5 model ki quality aur product analytics ko alag rakhta hai.
  • Aapki pehli API call 1 se, Topic 2 Capability table maanti hai ki aap pehle se ek bana sakte hain (API call, model ko bheja gaya message).
  • Tool calling aur workflows 25 se, Topic 10 Automation aur coding capabilities wahi ideas use karti hain.
  • Ek prototype aur ek PRD A7 se, Topic 1 Aap ek bana chuke hain. Yeh chapter dobara dekhta hai ki aapne uska tool kaise chuna.
  • Agents (tools ko loop mein use karne wale helpers) 26 se, Topic 10 Idea 4 mein ek agent aur fixed workflow ki tulna hoti hai.
  • Observability 30 se, Topic 11 Traces (ek run ki diary) harness ka ek hissa hain.
  • Security aur governance (cheezein safe rakhna, aur kaun kya kar sakta hai ke niyam) 31 se, Topic 11 Idea 3 ise tool permissions par lagata hai.
  • Failures haath se padhna (galat jawab ek-ek karke padhna) 14.5 se, Topic 7 Idea 4 failures ki list isi tarah banata hai.
  • Architecture aur vendor strategy (parts kaise jude hain, aur kis company se kharidna hai) 33 se, Topic 11 System-design interviews mein iske baare mein poochha jaata hai.
  • AI product management (tay karna ki AI product kya kare) 32 se, Topic 11 Interviewers umeed karte hain ki aap iske shabd use karein.

Aur gehraai mein (19)

  • Case The New Business of AI (and How It’s Different From Traditional Software) Casado and Bornstein, a16z, 2020AI companies ke gross margins, scaling aur moats, un investors se jinhone numbers dekhe.
  • Case Fin pricing: $0.99 per resolution IntercomVyavhaar mein outcome pricing: support agent ka bill har seat ki jagah har hal hui conversation par.
  • Case How Duolingo reignited user growth Jorge Mazal, Lenny’s Newsletter, 2023Streaks, leaderboards aur notifications, har ek test kiya hua, daily users mein 4.5 guna badhat ke peeche.
  • Case Klarna’s AI assistant handles two-thirds of customer service chats OpenAI customer story, 2024Sabse mashhoor support deployment: ek mahine mein 23 lakh chats. Ise un baad ki khabron ke saath padhiye ki Klarna ne log wapas rakhe.
  • Case The Surprising Power of Online Experiments Kohavi and Thomke, Harvard Business Review, 2017Saal mein hazaaron A/B tests chalane wali companies ko zyadatar ideas kaam karte kyun nahi milte, aur woh kya karti hain.
  • Case Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025: AI Stack OverflowHazaaron developers batate hain ki woh kaun se AI tools use karte hain, aur un par kitna bharosa karte hain. Bharose se zyada shak.
  • Case Building effective agents Anthropic engineering, 2024Pehle workflows, agents sirf wahan jahan steps pehle se pata na hon. Is vishay par sabse kaam ka page.
  • Case Effective context engineering for AI agents Anthropic engineering, 2025Agents banane wali ek team har step par kaise tay karti hai ki model ke saamne kya jaaye, aur kya bahar rahe.
  • Case Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149 BC Civil Resolution Tribunal, 2024Ek airline ke chatbot ne refund ka niyam khud bana diya aur airline ko use maanna pada. Chatbot jo kehta hai uski zimmedaari company ki hai.
  • Case State of the product job market Lenny’s NewsletterKhuli PM roles, AI PM roles aur hiring managers kya maangte hain, charts ke saath.
  • Case What We Learned from a Year of Building with LLMs Yan, Bischof, Frye, Husain, Liu, Shankar, O’Reilly, 2024Chhah practitioners batate hain ki production mein asal mein kya chala: prompts, retrieval, evals, aur kab model use nahi karna.
  • Paper FrugalGPT: How to Use Large Language Models While Reducing Cost and Improving Performance Chen, Zaharia and Zou, 2023Pehle saste phir mehnge models ki cascade ne sabse achhe model jitni quality bahut kam kharche mein di.
  • Paper Platform Competition in Two-Sided Markets Rochet and Tirole, Journal of the European Economic Association, 2003Aise products ki economics jo ek saath do groups ko serve karte hain, aur ek side ko aksar subsidy kyun milti hai. Network effects ki soch ki buniyaad.
  • Paper Controlled experiments on the web: survey and practical guide Kohavi et al., 2009Sample size, galtiyan aur overall evaluation criterion, us team se jo Microsoft mein experiments chalati thi.
  • Paper The Impact of AI on Developer Productivity: Evidence from GitHub Copilot Peng et al., 2023Ek controlled experiment: Copilot wale developers ne ek task 56% tez khatam kiya. Padhiye ki task kaise chuna gaya.
  • Paper Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity Becker et al., METR, 2025Anubhavi developers ko laga AI unhe 20% tez karega; naapne par woh 19% dheeme hue. Poochne ki jagah naapna kyun zaroori hai.
  • Paper Generative AI at Work Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond, NBER, 2023Tool chunne se pehle saboot: kiski madad hui, kitni, aur kaise naapa gaya.
  • Paper SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering Yang et al., Princeton, 2024Wahi model, uske aas-paas behtar tools aur screens, kahin zyada bugs theek. Harness hi product hai.
  • Paper Navigating the Jagged Technological Frontier Dell’Acqua et al., Harvard Business School and BCG, 2023758 consultants: AI ne kuch tasks par unhe tez aur behtar banaya aur kuch par kharab. Aisa pilot banaiye jo farq bata sake.

Is topic ke shabd (26)

Willingness to pay
Sochiye woh sabse zyaada rakam jo aap plumber ko denge jab paip phat jaye, jo leak kitni buri hai us par tikti hai, plumber ke kharche par nahi. Willingness to pay woh sabse zyaada hai jo khareedar kisi problem ko hal karne ke liye dega. Yeh is par tikta hai ki unka abhi ka vikalp unhe kitna padta hai, aapke kharche par nahi.
Contribution margin
Sochiye chai ki tapri: har customer se jo bachta hai doodh, cheeni aur madadgaar ka kharcha dene ke baad, jo har cup ke saath badhta hai. Contribution margin woh hai jo har customer aapke paas chhodta hai un kharchon ke baad jo unke saath badhte hain, jaise model calls aur support. Ise aam taur par revenue ke percentage mein dikhaya jaata hai.
Gross margin
Sochiye dukaan ki bikri minus maal ki laagat. Gross margin revenue minus product dene ki seedhi laagat hai. AI products mein model vendor ka bill us laagat ka bada hissa hota hai.
Flywheel
Sochiye ek bhaari chakka: ek baar ghoom jaye toh har dhakka agle ko aasaan bana deta hai. Flywheel ek loop hai jahan product use karne se woh behtar hota hai, jisse aur use hota hai. Yeh data par, kaam ki aadaton par ya doosron ke aap par banane par chal sakta hai.
Outcome pricing
Sochiye darzi ko har tayyar shirt ke hisaab se paisa dena, ghante ke hisaab se nahi. Outcome pricing ka matlab hai har safal nateeje ka paisa lena, jaise ek hal hua ticket, seats ya use ke bajaye. Iske liye safalta naapne ka ek tay tareeka chahiye.
AARRR
Sochiye paanch padaav wala raasta: log aapko jaante hain, aazmate hain, rukte hain, doston ko batate hain aur paisa dete hain. AARRR growth ke paanch stages hain: acquisition, activation, retention, referral aur revenue. Har stage ke liye ek event hota hai jise aap gin sakte hain.
Activation moment
Sochiye achhi chai ka pehla ghoont, jab customer kahe, "Haan, yahi chahiye tha." Activation moment woh pehli baar hai jab naya user woh value paata hai jiska aapka product vaada karta hai.
Time-to-value
Sochiye chai ka order dene se pehle ghoont tak kitni der lagti hai. Time-to-value woh samay hai jo naya user activation moment tak pahunchne mein leta hai, sign-up se naapa hua.
Growth loop
Sochiye dominoes ki kadi: har gira domino agle ko giraata hai. Growth loop ek chakra hai jahan ek user ke kaam agle user ko laate hain, isliye output wapas input mein jaata hai.
Network effect
Sochiye phone: akela bekaar, aur har dost ke paas hone se behtar. Network effect tab hota hai jab product mojooda users ke liye behtar hota hai jaise zyaada log use karte hain. Yeh virality se alag hai, jo sirf aur logon ko laati hai.
Virality
Sochiye mohalle mein failti afwah: zyaada log sunte hain, lekin afwah khud behtar nahi hoti. Virality tab hai jab users doosre users ko laate hain, jaise share karke. Yeh growth mein madad karti hai, lekin kisi ke liye product behtar nahi banati.
Dark pattern
Sochiye dukaan jahan nikalne ka darwaaza chhupa ho aur "haan, mujhe offers bhejo" ka dabba pehle se tick ho. Dark pattern aisa design hai jo users ko apne hi khilaaf kaam karne par phusla deta hai, jaise chhupa hua cancel button ya pehle se tick kiye invitations.
Product-led growth
Sochiye bazaar mein free sample ka stall: aap chakhte hain, pasand aata hai, aur bina salesman ke khareedte hain. Product-led growth ek go-to-market tareeka hai jahan users khud sign up karke value paate hain, aur kuchh paid mein badalte hain, bina sales se baat kiye.
Input metric
Sochiye cycle ke pedal: aap unhe seedha dabate hain, aur cycle tez hoti hai. Input metric woh number hai jise team seedha hila sakti hai, aur jisse aap umeed karte hain ki North Star metric hilega.
Event taxonomy
Sochiye label wala register jahan har event ko ek tay style mein ek naam milta hai. Event taxonomy un events ki list hai jo product log karta hai, ek naam rakhne ke niyam ke saath jo sab maante hain, jaise object_action.
Tracking plan
Sochiye office ki deewar par lagi saajhi checklist. Tracking plan woh saajha document hai jismein har event, uski properties, woh kab chalta hai aur uska maalik kaun hai, likha hota hai.
Funnel
Sochiye tel daalne ki funnel: upar chauri, neeche sankri. Funnel un users ka hissa hai jo kisi process ka har step kram mein poora karte hain. Yeh dikhata hai ki log kahan chhodte hain.
Cohort
Sochiye school ka batch: sab jo ek hi saal mein aaye. Cohort un users ka group hai jinhone ek hi samay mein shuru kiya. Retention tables har cohort ko samay ke saath follow karte hain.
Minimum detectable effect
Sochiye tarazu jo 10 gram se kam nahi dikha sakta: usse neeche aap farq nahi bata sakte. Minimum detectable effect sabse chhota badlaav hai jo ek experiment pakadne ke liye banaya gaya hai. Isi se tay hota hai ki test ko kitne users chahiye.
Selection bias
Sochiye class kaisi rahi, yeh sirf aage ki line ke students se poochhna. Selection bias tab hota hai jab aapke data ke log un logon se alag hon jinke baare mein aap jaanna chahte hain, jaise chun-chun kar liye gaye shuruaati users.
State machine
Sochiye saanp-seedhi ka board: har khaana aur har chaal pehle se tay. State machine ek workflow hai jahan code har step aur har badlaav tay karta hai. Jo step fail hota hai woh hamesha pata hota hai.
Bounded agent
Sochiye ek madadgaar jiske paas errands ki list, tay auzaar aur ghar lautne ka waqt hai. Bounded agent woh agent hai jo apne steps khud chunta hai, lekin sirf ek tay tool list se aur step budget aur approval rules ke andar.
Design partner
Sochiye padosi jo aapka aadha pakka khaana chakhne aur kya kami hai bataane ko raazi ho. Design partner ek shuruaati user hai jo adhoore product ko use karne aur jo mile woh batane ko raazi hota hai, saaf sahmati ke saath.
Changelog
Sochiye dukaan ke darwaaze par lagi suchna ki is hafte kya badla. Changelog har release mein kya badla, kyun, aur users ko kya alag karna chahiye, uska chhota saarvajanik note hai.
Role matrix
Sochiye ek table jismein side mein job ads aur upar skills hain, jahan job kisi skill ko maangti hai wahan tick. Role matrix asli job descriptions ka grid hai jo unki maangi skills ke saamne rakha jaata hai, taaki pata chale ki market kaun si skills chahta hai aur aapki kami kahan hai.
A/B test
Sochiye do groups ke customers ko ek hi din do alag menu dena, aur ginna ki kaun sa zyaada bikta hai. A/B test do random groups ke users ko ek hi samay par do versions dikhata hai aur dono ke beech ek number ki tulna karta hai, taaki aap bata sakein ki farq kis version ne kiya.
Tools: PDF, spreadsheet, har topic kholna

App, kitaab aur plan ke links isi page ke bagal mein khulte hain, taaki aapki jagah kabhi na khoye.

Yeh page har baar site banne par course, kitaab aur plan se banta hai, isliye hamesha unse milta hai. Ticks un teeno jagah se aate hain; notes aur “samjha sakta/sakti hoon” yahan save hote hain.
